66482.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓幾近全滿 (A)，PAX5 標出廣泛 CLL 浸潤 (B)、CD34 顯示母細胞聚集區 (C)；高倍 CD71 與 CD61 標出部分母細胞 (E、F)，而 p53 在母細胞區呈強而瀰漫的核染色、CLL 區較弱 (G)，用以判斷 TP53 突變來源。
features: Panel A: hypercellular marrow core at low power with near-complete loss of fat
Panel B: PAX5 highlights a diffuse interstitial B-cell infiltrate (CLL); Panel C: CD34 shows a dense cluster of positive blasts in a separate region
Panel D: H&E at higher power shows sheets of intermediate-sized cells with scattered atypical megakaryocytes
Panels E–F: CD71 and CD61 stain a subset of scattered larger cells, indicating erythroid and megakaryocytic differentiation
Panel G: p53 shows strong nuclear staining in a large subset of cells in one region, contrasting with weaker, heterogeneous staining elsewhere
66482.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular (approximately 95%) with near-total replacement of fat. PAX5 immunostaining highlights an extensive interstitial B-cell infiltrate corresponding to the known chronic lymphocytic leukemia, while CD34 shows a separate, geographically distinct population of increased blasts. Higher power shows atypical megakaryocytes, and subsets of blasts express CD71 and CD61. p53 immunohistochemistry demonstrates diffuse strong nuclear overexpression in the blast population, in contrast to the heterogeneous weak-to-moderate (wild-type pattern) staining of the CLL cells. Findings are consistent with concurrent CLL and acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid/megakaryocytic differentiation, with the p53-overexpression pattern localizing the TP53 mutation to the AML compartment.

ddx.vs: Richter transformation consists of sheets of large PAX5/CD20-positive B cells, whereas the large cells here are CD34, CD71 and CD61 positive myeloid blasts.
Prolymphocytes are PAX5-positive B cells and would not account for the CD34-positive, CD71/CD61-positive population.
MDS-IB shows <20% blasts, so separation from AML depends on blast enumeration in the aspirate and CD34 extent.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic or pure erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: These show a dominant single lineage, whereas here blasts show mixed CD71 and CD61 subsets with a separate CD34 population.

66482.stain: H&E; IHC: PAX5, CD34, CD71, CD61, p53

66418.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆前紅血球母細胞與早期顆粒球前驅細胞的細胞質邊緣聚集小圓形空泡 (cytoplasmic vacuoles)，並可見形狀不規則的晚期紅血球母細胞，呈銅缺乏 (copper deficiency) 常見的紅系與骨髓系空泡化。
features: Large proerythroblasts and early granulocytic precursors with clusters of small clear vacuoles at the cytoplasmic periphery
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm in erythroid precursors with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
A promyelocyte/myelocyte with granules and prominent vacuoles (center)
Late erythroblasts with irregular nuclear contours and a cluster of dysplastic-appearing erythroid cells (bottom center)
Few mature neutrophils and a band form; an eosinophil precursor at right
66418.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted erythropoiesis in which proerythroblasts contain multiple small cytoplasmic vacuoles, together with late erythroblasts showing irregular nuclear contours consistent with dyserythropoiesis. Granulocytic precursors are also left-shifted and include vacuolated promyelocytes and myelocytes, with relatively few mature neutrophils. Blasts are not increased in this field. The combination of erythroid and myeloid precursor vacuolation is consistent with acquired copper deficiency in the given clinical context; correlation with serum copper, ceruloplasmin and zinc is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS shows persistent dysplasia with clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities, while copper-deficiency changes reverse after copper repletion.
AML shows ≥20% blasts, whereas here maturing vacuolated precursors predominate without a blast population.
Toxic vacuolation is morphologically similar and is separated by exposure history and normal copper levels.

66290.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆與中性球差不多大小的細胞，細胞質與細胞核上佈滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，把細胞核輪廓遮蓋得模糊不清，只隱約看到分葉核；這種遮核的粗大深色顆粒就是嗜鹼性球（basophil）的特徵。
features: Cell of neutrophil size (about 10-14 µm), round outline
Numerous coarse, dark purple-black granules scattered over both cytoplasm and nucleus
Nucleus obscured by granules; faintly lobulated/segmented outline with condensed chromatin
Pale pink-lavender cytoplasmic background visible between granules
Surrounding red cells normocytic and normochromic; a single platelet present
66290.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single round granulocyte of neutrophil size whose cytoplasm and nucleus are overlain by coarse, dark purple-black granules that partially obscure a segmented nucleus. The background red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and a platelet is present. Findings are consistent with a normal basophil; if basophils are increased in number, correlation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as CML is warranted.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round, non-lobed central nucleus and densely packed, uniform smaller granules, and are rarely seen in blood outside mast cell leukemia.
Toxic granules are finer, lie only in the cytoplasm and do not obscure the clearly visible segmented nucleus.
Eosinophils have refractile orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm with a bilobed nucleus that remains visible.
Precipitate lies in a different focal plane and extends onto adjacent red cells and background, rather than being confined within the cell outline.

66162.recognize_zh: 低倍（4x）CD68 免疫染色的骨髓切片，骨小梁之間有大片、地圖狀融合的深棕色陽性區域，代表大量組織球（含 Gaucher 細胞）浸潤；其間為藍色陰性的造血組織。
features: Low-power trephine core with thin trabeculae
Large geographic confluent sheets of brown CD68-positive cells occupying much of the intertrabecular marrow
Positive cells have abundant cytoplasm with diffuse granular staining
Intervening CD68-negative hematopoietic tissue with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Single-cell morphology not assessable at 4x
66162.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy immunostained for CD68 shows large confluent geographic sheets of CD68-positive histiocytes occupying a substantial proportion of the intertrabecular marrow, separated by CD68-negative hematopoietic tissue. CD68 confirms the histiocytic nature of the infiltrate but does not distinguish Gaucher cells from other macrophages. In correlation with morphology, PAS and TRAP staining, findings are consistent with extensive infiltration by Gaucher cells and histiocytes.

ddx.vs: HLH shows scattered CD68/CD163-positive macrophages containing ingested cells rather than confluent sheets of storage cells.
CD68 KP1 also stains myeloid cells, so CD163 or PGM1 and morphology are needed to confirm a histiocytic rather than granulocytic infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Langerhans cell histiocytosis or Erdheim-Chester disease
ddx.vs: LCH cells are CD1a and langerin positive with grooved nuclei, and Erdheim-Chester foamy histiocytes are CD1a negative, BRAF-mutated and associated with fibrosis.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes are CD68 positive but acid-fast bacilli are demonstrable on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.

65650.recognize_zh: 同一低倍視野裡有五顆嗜中性球，其中多顆核分成 5–6 葉、部分小葉呈環狀排列；多數嗜中性球都分葉過多，比單一細胞更能說明是真實的分葉過多而非偶發現象。
features: Five neutrophils in one low-power field, most with increased lobation
Several cells with 5-6 small rounded lobes, some arranged in a ring-like pattern
Condensed mature chromatin; cells of normal size
Pale cytoplasm with fine to moderately coarse granules
Background red cells normocytic, many with central pallor; platelets present
65650.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low to medium power shows five neutrophils in a single field, the majority with five to six nuclear lobes, some arranged in a ring-like configuration. The neutrophils are of normal size with mature chromatin and fine to moderately coarse granules. Red cells appear normocytic without obvious macro-ovalocytes, and platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation involving many neutrophils; evaluation for vitamin B12/folate deficiency, drug effect, or an inherited trait is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia usually shows accompanying macro-ovalocytes, anisopoikilocytosis, and cytopenias, which are not evident in this field.
Hereditary hypersegmentation affects most neutrophils in a well patient with normal B12 and folate and a positive family history.
Pelger-Huët neutrophils are hyposegmented with bilobed or round nuclei, the opposite of the multilobed nuclei here.
Ring neutrophils have a continuous annular nucleus without discrete lobes.

65458.recognize_zh: 這顆嗜中性球的細胞質被密集、粗大的深紫紅色顆粒塞滿，連分葉核都被遮住，看起來很像嗜鹼性球；這是極密集的 Alder-Reilly 包涵體。
features: Mature neutrophil-sized cell with a lobated nucleus partly obscured by granules
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse dark purple-red granules
Granules evenly distributed and overlying the nucleus
No cytoplasmic vacuolation or Döhle bodies
Background red cells unremarkable
65458.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil-sized cell whose cytoplasm is densely packed with coarse, dark purple-red granules that partly obscure the lobated nucleus. Toxic vacuolation and Döhle bodies are not present. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with dense Alder-Reilly inclusions in a neutrophil, which should prompt evaluation for a mucopolysaccharidosis.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are larger, more variable, blue-black, and soluble, whereas this cell has uniform dense purple-red granules and neutrophil-type lobation in a patient with inclusions in other leukocytes.
Toxic granulation is less dense, often accompanied by vacuoles and Döhle bodies, and occurs during infection rather than as a constitutional finding.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant irregular inclusions rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.

65394.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆漿細胞核偏位、細胞質深藍帶核周淡染區（perinuclear hof），並可見雙核、三核漿細胞，背景紅血球排成錢串狀（rouleaux），符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleated and trinucleated plasma cells, including a large multinucleated form
Nuclei with coarse 'clock-face' chromatin; some cells larger with more open chromatin
Marked rouleaux formation of red cells in the background
Occasional admixed neutrophils
65394.describe_en: Composite bone marrow aspirate fields show numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing. Many are atypical, including binucleated and multinucleated forms and larger cells with less condensed chromatin. The background red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, reflecting a serum paraprotein. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification of plasma cells on the aspirate and core, with light-chain restriction studies, is needed.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, mononuclear, usually under 10% and polytypic, without multinucleation or prominent rouleaux.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than sheets of atypical multinucleated plasma cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters without a perinuclear hof and is cytokeratin-positive and CD138-variable but light-chain-negative.

65266.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中單獨一顆比紅血球大的圓形細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻均勻，細胞質只剩邊緣一圈，看起來是母細胞（blast）；但此圖核仁不清楚、也看不到顆粒，無法僅憑形態確認為骨髓母細胞。
features: Single mononuclear cell roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of cytoplasm, slightly broader on one side
Round to oval nucleus with finely dispersed, evenly stippled chromatin
Nucleoli and cytoplasmic azurophilic granules or Auer rods not discernible in this image
Background red cells without obvious poikilocytosis; intensely eosinophilic staining tone
65266.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating immature mononuclear cell among normocytic red cells. The cell is about twice the size of a red cell, with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a round nucleus with fine, open chromatin, and a scant rim of cytoplasm. Nucleoli, granules, and Auer rods are not clearly resolved, and the strong eosinophilic cast of the stain limits assessment of cytoplasmic basophilia. The cell has blast morphology, suggestive of a myeloblast; lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry or cytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts tend to be smaller with more condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and no granules, and lineage is ultimately separated by MPO and flow cytometry (CD34/CD117/MPO vs TdT/CD19 or cCD3).
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and coarser chromatin, rather than a scant rim with fine blastic chromatin.
Promyelocytes are larger with more cytoplasm containing abundant azurophilic granules and a perinuclear Golgi hof, features not seen here.

65202.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈高度細胞性、以顆粒球系及嗜酸性球增生為主，合併網狀纖維明顯增加（MF-3），且紅血球前驅細胞聚成大片簇狀、E-cadherin 陽性，這種「嗜酸性球＋纖維化＋紅系母細胞群聚」組合提示 JAK2 融合的骨髓/淋巴腫瘤（PCM1::JAK2）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with expanded granulopoiesis and increased eosinophils
Enlarged megakaryocytes with hyperlobated nuclei (MPN-like), highlighted by factor VIII
Dense diffuse reticulin fibrosis with coarse intersecting fibers (MF-3)
Large clusters/sheets of immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei, open chromatin and clear to amphophilic cytoplasm
E-cadherin immunostain highlights the clustered immature erythroid precursors
65202.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with marked granulocytic proliferation including increased eosinophils, and scattered enlarged megakaryocytes with MPN-like hyperlobated nuclei. Reticulin stain demonstrates diffuse and dense fibrosis (MF-3). There are prominent clusters of immature erythroid precursors, highlighted by E-cadherin immunostaining. The combination of eosinophilia, fibrosis and aggregates of immature erythroid precursors is suggestive of a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and JAK2 rearrangement (e.g., PCM1::JAK2), to be confirmed by cytogenetic or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes and fibrosis but typically lacks prominent eosinophilia and sheets of E-cadherin-positive immature erythroid precursors; molecular testing for JAK2 fusion separates them.
CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes and requires BCR::ABL1, which was negative here.
AEL shows sheets of pronormoblasts making up most of the cellularity (often p53 strong), whereas here erythroid clusters are admixed with a dominant granulocytic/eosinophilic proliferation.
These share eosinophilia and fibrosis and cannot be separated morphologically; FISH/NGS fusion testing identifies the specific tyrosine kinase partner.

65202.stain: H&E; reticulin; IHC: E-cadherin, factor VIII

65074.recognize_zh: 巨噬細胞的淡藍泡沫狀細胞質內散布大量小圓到橢圓形的紫色蟲體，部分可見旁邊的小點狀或短棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），另夾雜棕黑色色素顆粒；細胞內大量含動基體的小蟲體是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體的辨認重點。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous small 2-4 micron intracellular bodies
Organisms show purple nuclei; a smaller dark dot or rod-shaped kinetoplast is discernible in some
Scattered brown-black refractile pigment granules within the cytoplasm (probable hemosiderin or phagocytosed debris)
Macrophage nucleus(es) round with reticular chromatin
Adjacent large cell with a round nucleus and finely stippled chromatin, plus background RBCs and myeloid cells
65074.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous small oval intracytoplasmic organisms. The organisms have a distinct nucleus and, in many, an adjacent smaller rod-shaped kinetoplast; there is no refractile capsule or budding. Brown pigment granules are also present within the macrophage cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes, supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear pseudocapsular halo and narrow-based budding and lack the kinetoplast seen here.

ddx.dx: Platelets or granules phagocytosed by macrophages
ddx.vs: Engulfed platelets and granules are irregular and lack the paired nucleus-kinetoplast structure of amastigotes.
T. marneffei yeasts are elongated with a central septum from binary fission and no kinetoplast.
HLH macrophages contain whole engulfed blood cells rather than numerous uniform small organisms.

65138.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央的嗜中性白血球細胞質內有數顆大小不一、圓形且與細胞核同色的深紫色小顆粒，排列在核旁，形態像紅血球中的 Howell-Jolly body，屬於嗜中性球內 Howell-Jolly body 樣包涵物。
features: Neutrophil containing several (about 4-5) small, round, dense dark purple cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions stain like nuclear chromatin and are well-circumscribed, varying slightly in size
Host neutrophil nucleus lobulated/clumped with pink cytoplasm
A second round leukocyte with dense clumped chromatin below, without clear inclusions
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes, likely artifactual) with stacked red cells in thicker areas; normal-appearing platelets
65138.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing several small, round, sharply defined cytoplasmic inclusions that stain dark purple, similar to nuclear chromatin, located adjacent to the nucleus. These resemble Howell-Jolly bodies and are distinct from pale blue Dohle bodies or coarse toxic granules. A second leukocyte in the field lacks such inclusions. The background shows crenated red cells and red cell stacking in thicker areas, with platelets present. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in neutrophils, which are associated with immunosuppressive or cytotoxic drugs (e.g., mycophenolate, chemotherapy), HIV infection or transplantation.

ddx.vs: Dohle bodies are pale blue-grey, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches of rough ER, not dense round purple chromatin-like dots.
Morulae are stippled, mulberry-like clusters of basophilic organisms, larger and granular rather than smooth homogeneous round dots.
Platelets show granular purple centers with pale periphery and lie in a different focal plane, whereas these inclusions are uniformly dense and within the cytoplasm.
Apoptotic cells show complete nuclear pyknosis with multiple condensed fragments replacing the nucleus, whereas here the lobulated nucleus remains intact.

64882.recognize_zh: 九格拼圖中每格都有一端鈍圓、另一端逐漸變細成單一尾巴的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocyte），尾端朝向不一且非同一方向排列，排除抹片拉扯假象，大量出現時提示原發性骨髓纖維化。
features: Multiple teardrop-shaped red cells (dacrocytes) with a single tapered tail
Tails of variable length, pointing in different directions (not artifactual)
Background mild anisocytosis with some elongated cells
One red cell with a small inclusion suggestive of a Howell-Jolly body
One neutrophil with coarse nuclear lobes and scattered platelets, some large
64882.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear montage shows numerous dacrocytes with a single tapered tail of variable length, oriented randomly across fields, which argues against a spreading artifact. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elongated forms, and platelets include some large forms. Nucleated red cells and immature myeloid cells are not captured in these cropped panels. Frequent teardrop cells suggest marrow infiltration or fibrosis; in the appropriate setting with a leukoerythroblastic picture and JAK2, CALR, or MPL mutation, findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Artifactual teardrops all point in the same direction of the smear, whereas true dacrocytes have randomly oriented tails.

ddx.dx: Myelophthisis from metastatic carcinoma or other marrow infiltration
ddx.vs: Morphology of teardrops is identical; marrow biopsy and absence of MPN driver mutations separate secondary infiltration.
Thalassemia shows teardrops together with marked hypochromic microcytosis and target cells.
Elliptocytes are symmetric with both ends rounded, without a single tapered tail.

64498.recognize_zh: 四格圖中的中等大小淋巴細胞，核圓或卵圓、部分略呈腎形，染色質細緻均勻、無明顯核仁，周圍有豐富淡灰藍色細胞質並向四周伸出細毛狀突起，正是毛細胞（hairy cell）。
features: Medium to large lymphoid cells, about 1.5-2 times the size of a red cell, with moderate N:C ratio
Round, oval to slightly indented/kidney-shaped nuclei
Homogeneous, finely stippled 'ground-glass' chromatin, paler than a small lymphocyte, without conspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
No cytoplasmic granules; background red cells unremarkable
64498.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite) shows medium to large lymphoid cells with round to oval or slightly indented nuclei, finely stippled homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have abundant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E or annexin A1 is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus and more condensed chromatin with leukocytosis, and are CD25-, CD123-, annexin A1- and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes are smaller with more clumped chromatin and short polar (bipolar) villi rather than circumferential projections, and lack CD103/CD25/annexin A1.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles, and lack circumferential hairy projections.

ddx.dx: Reactive or atypical lymphocytes with drying artifact
ddx.vs: Artifactual cytoplasmic fraying is uneven and seen in scattered cells, whereas hairy cells show consistent fine projections with ground-glass chromatin and a CD103+ CD25+ CD11c+ phenotype.

64562.recognize_zh: 上方與右側的嗜酸性球顆粒稀少、細胞質粉紅或淡藍空白，核分葉增多；右下一個嗜酸性細胞顆粒粗大分布不均；左下嗜中性球細胞質幾乎無顆粒，顯示嗜酸性與嗜中性系都有低顆粒化的發育異常。
features: Hypogranular eosinophil with multilobated nucleus and pale cytoplasm containing few granules (top)
Eosinophil with pink, nearly agranular cytoplasm and lobulated nucleus (right)
Larger eosinophil with coarse, unevenly distributed granules and eccentric nucleus (lower right)
Hypogranular neutrophil with agranular pale pink cytoplasm and segmented nucleus (lower left)
Background red cells unremarkable; small platelet clumps present
64562.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophils with dysplastic features, including marked hypogranulation with pale or pink agranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear lobation. One larger eosinophil shows coarse, unevenly distributed granules. A hypogranular neutrophil is present in the lower left. Findings are suggestive of a myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and multilineage granulocytic dysplasia, and genetic testing for PDGFRA rearrangement is warranted.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplasia across lineages with cytopenias but not a marked eosinophilia, and lacks tyrosine kinase fusions.
Activated eosinophils in allergic or parasitic states can appear partially degranulated, so separation depends on clinical context and clonal studies.
Stain or storage artifact affects all cells uniformly, whereas here hypogranular cells coexist with normally granulated ones on the same slide.

64434.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中在一片均一的淋巴母細胞背景上，可見數個大型組織球，細胞質內吞噬了多個完整或退化的母細胞與空泡（母細胞吞噬）；搭配縱膈腔增寬、雙側腎臟腫大影像與骨髓 T 淋巴母細胞浸潤，符合 T-ALL。
features: Panel E (pleural fluid): uniform background of medium-sized lymphoblasts with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Large histiocytes with abundant foamy/vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed intact and degenerating blasts
Panel C (PB): medium-sized blast with agranular basophilic cytoplasm, dispersed chromatin and irregular nucleus
Panel D (BM): numerous blasts with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm replacing normal hematopoiesis
Panel A: chest radiograph with mediastinal widening and pleural effusions; panel B: CT with massive bilateral nephromegaly
64434.describe_en: Peripheral blood shows occasional medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, agranular basophilic cytoplasm and dispersed chromatin, and the bone marrow aspirate is extensively infiltrated by similar blasts. Pleural fluid cytology shows a monotonous population of lymphoblasts together with numerous histiocytes containing phagocytosed blasts at various stages of degradation, without phagocytosis of red cells. Imaging demonstrates mediastinal widening with pleural effusions and bilateral nephromegaly. With a cortical T-cell immunophenotype (cCD3+, CD7+, CD5+, CD1a+), findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia with blast phagocytosis by histiocytes in the pleural effusion.

ddx.vs: HLH shows histiocytes ingesting red cells, platelets and neutrophils with clinical HLH criteria, whereas here histiocytes engulf blasts selectively and HLH criteria were not met.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and are CD10+/sIg+ B cells with MYC rearrangement, unlike these agranular CD1a+ T-lymphoblasts.
Reactive effusions contain small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin rather than monotonous blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts have abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase-positive, whereas these blasts are scant-cytoplasm TdT/cCD3+ lymphoblasts.

64178.recognize_zh: 紅血球大範圍排成疊錢狀（rouleaux）長串，背景中散在數顆小型成熟樣淋巴球，核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質極少；循環淋巴瘤細胞加上 paraprotein 造成的 rouleaux，提示 Waldenström macroglobulinemia。
features: Prominent rouleaux: red cells stacked in long coin-like chains throughout the thin area of the film
Several small lymphoid cells only slightly larger than red cells, with very high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with coarse, clumped but somewhat open chromatin; no visible nucleoli
Scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm; distinct plasmacytoid features are not evident in this field
One pale, disrupted cell at the lower center consistent with a smudged/degenerated cell
Scattered small refractile dots on red cells, most likely drying artifact
64178.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked rouleaux formation, with red cells arranged in long stacked chains even in the thin portion of the film, implying an increased plasma protein such as a paraprotein. Scattered small lymphoid cells are present, with round nuclei, coarse but slightly open chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm; one smudged cell is also seen. Definite plasmacytoid lymphocytes or plasma cells are not identified in this field. In the appropriate clinical setting (IgM paraprotein, MYD88 L265P), the findings are consistent with circulating lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia).

ddx.vs: CLL cells have more coarsely clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin with numerous smudge cells and typically lack rouleaux; flow shows CD5+/CD23+ with dim sIg rather than a CD5-negative IgM-bearing clone.
Myeloma also causes rouleaux, but circulating cells, if present, are plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs, and the paraprotein is usually IgG/IgA rather than IgM.
SMZL may show IgM paraprotein and rouleaux but circulating cells often have polar villous projections, and MYD88 L265P is usually absent.
Pseudo-rouleaux is confined to thick parts of the film, whereas here stacking persists where cells are otherwise separated.

64114.recognize_zh: 中央一顆組織球，胞質深藍、邊緣不規則，自身核被推到上方呈新月狀，胞質內包著一顆分葉的顆粒球核與粉紅色顆粒物質；組織球吞噬完整的骨髓細胞，是 HLH 典型的噬血現象。
features: Histiocyte with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and irregular, ragged borders
Histiocyte nucleus compressed into a crescent at the upper pole
Engulfed granulocyte with a dark lobulated nucleus within the cytoplasm
Adjacent pink-red granular material, likely ingested granulocyte granules or red cell debris
Background: an immature granulocyte with azurophilic granules (upper left) and crenated red cells from slow drying
64114.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a histiocyte with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm whose own nucleus is displaced into a crescent by ingested material. The cytoplasm contains an intact granulocyte with a dark lobulated nucleus and adjacent pink granular debris. An immature granulocytic cell and crenated red cells are present in the background. The findings represent hemophagocytosis; since isolated hemophagocytes are nonspecific, a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis requires correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or infection
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical hemophagocytes occur without HLH; the syndrome is defined by clinical/laboratory criteria rather than by finding such a cell.

ddx.dx: Cell overlapping a monocyte or myelocyte
ddx.vs: Overlap lacks nuclear displacement of the host cell and a surrounding vacuole, whereas here the host nucleus is compressed by the ingested cell.
Megakaryocytes are larger with granular lilac cytoplasm and a multilobated nucleus, unlike this basophilic histiocyte with a crescentic nucleus.

ddx.dx: Leukemic blasts with cannibalism (e.g., AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: Erythrophagocytosis or leukophagocytosis by blasts shows immature host cells with fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than a mature histiocyte.

64050.recognize_zh: 視野中有兩顆體積很大、胞質豐富且呈粉紫色細顆粒狀的巨噬細胞（macrophage），其中一顆旁邊/內有一顆小圓核細胞，下方為一群深藍胞質的紅血球前驅細胞，顯示骨髓中巨噬細胞明顯增多。
features: Two large macrophages with abundant, finely granular to foamy pink-purple cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Macrophage nuclei oval to reniform with open chromatin
A small round dense nucleus closely associated with the left macrophage, possibly an engulfed or overlying cell
Cluster of erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a larger immature erythroid cell below
Blood-rich aspirate background with scattered platelets
64050.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows two prominent macrophages with abundant, finely granular, pale pink-purple cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei; a small round nucleated cell lies closely apposed to one macrophage, although definite phagocytosis cannot be confirmed in this field. A cluster of basophilic erythroid precursors, including a larger immature erythroid cell, is also present. Clear engulfed red cells or platelets are not evident in these macrophages. The increased, activated macrophages support, but are not by themselves diagnostic of, a hemophagocytic process in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Increased macrophages without convincing phagocytosed blood cells are nonspecific and require HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria to diagnose HLH.
Gaucher cells have 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and Niemann-Pick cells have uniform bubbly foamy vacuoles, unlike these granular activated macrophages.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated dense nuclei and granular cytoplasm with platelet budding, whereas macrophages have a single oval nucleus with open chromatin.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli, unlike these single bland macrophages with low N:C ratio.

63922.recognize_zh: 這是折線圖而非形態學：縱軸為血中 EBV PCR 定量（gEq/mL），病毒量從 10 月底近零逐步升到約 66,000，類固醇治療後短暫下降，隨後再升至約 114,000；第一劑 rituximab（抗 CD20）後迅速降到約 11,800，說明 B 細胞內 EBV 複製對清除 B 細胞的治療有反應。
features: Line graph of quantitative EBV PCR (gEq/mL) versus date from late October to late December 2021
Gradual rise from near zero to about 12,000 (early November) and about 66,000 (late November)
Arrow marking steroid therapy near the first peak, followed by a transient fall to about 24,000
Rebound to about 91,000, 100,000 and a peak of about 114,000 in mid-December
Arrow marking the first rituximab dose at the peak, followed by a sharp fall to about 11,800
63922.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic line graph showing serial quantitative EBV DNA PCR results in blood after allogeneic stem cell transplantation. Viral load rose progressively from near zero to approximately 66,000 gEq/mL, fell transiently to about 24,000 gEq/mL after steroid therapy for GVHD, then rebounded to a peak of approximately 114,000 gEq/mL. After the first dose of rituximab, the viral load fell abruptly to approximately 11,800 gEq/mL. The graph illustrates uncontrolled post-transplant EBV reactivation with a prompt virologic response to pre-emptive anti-CD20 therapy, which should be interpreted alongside clinical and histologic assessment for post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: PTLD requires tissue showing a lymphoproliferation (mass lesion or destructive infiltrate with EBER-positive cells), whereas viremia alone indicates reactivation without proving PTLD.
A single aberrant value would not form a consistent trend, whereas serial concordant rises and a treatment-linked fall support true viral kinetics.

63730.recognize_zh: 粗箭頭處是一顆巨大的成熟巨核細胞，粉紫色細顆粒胞質中包著多顆完整的嗜中性球與幼紅血球，這些細胞位於胞質內而非疊在表面，就是穿核現象（emperipolesis）；細箭頭指的是較小、胞質深藍的嗜鹼性（未成熟）巨核細胞。
features: Large mature megakaryocyte with abundant pale lilac finely granular cytoplasm and lobulated nucleus (thick arrow)
Multiple intact hematopoietic cells (neutrophils/granulocytes and erythroid precursors) sitting within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, each with a clear halo
Engulfed cells retain normal nuclear detail, indicating viable passage rather than phagocytic degradation
Smaller basophilic megakaryocyte with dense deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a single large nucleus (thin arrow)
Background of marrow particle with scattered granulocytes and erythroid cells
63730.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm and a lobulated nucleus, containing numerous intact hematopoietic cells, including granulocytes and erythroid precursors, within its cytoplasm, each surrounded by a clear halo. The engulfed cells show preserved nuclear morphology, consistent with emperipolesis rather than phagocytosis. An adjacent smaller megakaryocyte with deeply basophilic cytoplasm represents an immature (basophilic) megakaryocyte. Megakaryocytic emperipolesis is a nonspecific finding that can be increased in reactive states, myeloproliferative neoplasms (notably primary myelofibrosis) and gray platelet syndrome.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis a macrophage with a bean-shaped nucleus contains degraded, pyknotic cells in phagocytic vacuoles, whereas here a lobulated megakaryocyte contains intact viable cells.
Overlying cells lie in a different focal plane without a surrounding clear halo within the cytoplasm.
RDD shows lymphocytes within large S-100-positive histiocytes with vesicular nuclei, not within megakaryocytes.
Osteoclasts have multiple separate round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus, and do not contain intact hematopoietic cells.

63666.recognize_zh: 視野中多數是核質比極高、染色質細緻的母細胞（blast），其中數顆（箭頭）一端伸出一小段細胞質尾巴（uropod），整體外形像一面手鏡，稱為手鏡細胞（hand mirror cell）。
features: Small to medium blasts with very high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Several blasts with a single short polar cytoplasmic tail (uropod), giving a hand-mirror shape
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells overlapping in thicker areas; no mature granulocytes in the field
63666.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small to medium-sized blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Several blasts (arrows) show a single polar cytoplasmic projection (uropod), imparting a hand-mirror configuration. No Auer rods are identified. In the context of acute lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts with hand-mirror morphology, a nonspecific feature that requires flow cytometry for lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts or monoblasts may also form uropods but often have more cytoplasm, granules, or Auer rods and express MPO or myelomonocytic markers.
Drag artifact produces long thin tails oriented in one direction in thick areas rather than a short blunt uropod on well-spread cells.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles.
Mature lymphocytes have condensed, clumped chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin.

63538.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球偏小、大小形狀不一，箭頭標出數個細長鐮刀狀細胞、標靶細胞（target cells）與一顆有核紅血球（nRBC），合併小球性變化，符合鐮刀型細胞/β+ 地中海貧血。
features: Moderate anisopoikilocytosis with many small red cells
Scattered elongated sickle cells with pointed ends (arrows)
Few target cells with central hemoglobin condensation
Occasional nucleated red blood cell (nRBC)
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes), most likely a drying/storage artifact
Occasional teardrop-like forms; neutrophils and platelets present
63538.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisopoikilocytosis with a population of small red cells. Scattered irreversibly sickled cells, a few target cells, and an occasional nucleated red blood cell are present, along with rare teardrop-like forms. Many red cells show crenation, which is most likely artifactual and should not be over-interpreted; hypochromia is difficult to judge because of this. Findings are consistent with a sickling disorder with microcytic features, supporting compound heterozygous sickle cell/β+ thalassemia; confirmation requires hemoglobin fractionation showing HbS with some HbA, increased HbA2, and variable HbF.

ddx.vs: HbSS usually shows more numerous sickle cells with normocytic indices and Howell-Jolly bodies from autosplenectomy, and HbA is absent on electrophoresis, whereas HbS/β+ thal retains some HbA with microcytosis.
HbSC shows many target cells and angular SC poikilocytes or HbC crystals with few classic sickle cells, and electrophoresis shows roughly equal HbS and HbC.
Sickle trait smears are essentially normal without sickle cells or nucleated red cells.
β-thalassemia shows microcytosis, target cells, and nRBCs but no sickle cells, and lacks HbS on electrophoresis.

63346.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球胞質內有粗大的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），在核上方另有數個不規則、帶折光的藍綠色包涵體（blue-green crystals），周圍紅血球呈鋸齒狀（echinocytes）；藍綠色包涵體是重症、肝衰竭與預後極差的線索。
features: Neutrophil with coarse dark toxic granulation throughout the cytoplasm
Several irregular refractile blue-green cytoplasmic inclusions adjacent to the nucleus
Poorly segmented, band-like dense nucleus
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles near the inclusions
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes)
Low-resolution, color-cast image; Döhle bodies not clearly separable from the inclusions
63346.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a dense band-like nucleus and prominent coarse toxic granulation. The cytoplasm contains several irregular, refractile blue-green inclusions with adjacent clear vacuoles. Surrounding red cells show crenation (echinocytes). Image resolution limits assessment of Döhle bodies. Findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophilic inclusions ('green crystals of death'), which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and high short-term mortality.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale gray-blue, homogeneous, non-refractile peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than bright irregular green crystals.
Microorganisms have uniform shapes (cocci, rods, budding yeasts) and stain purple-blue rather than refractile green.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown to blue-black and Prussian blue-positive, whereas the green inclusions are lipofuscin-like and iron-negative.
Giant granules or Alder-Reilly granules are inherited, involve many granulocytes uniformly and are not refractile green.

63282.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有兩顆胞質豐富淡藍、帶細顆粒、只有單一大圓核的巨核細胞（箭頭），核未分葉，屬於單核／低分葉巨核細胞異生，周圍夾雜帶核仁的芽細胞，支持 AML 伴骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Two large cells with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and a single large round non-lobated nucleus (arrow), consistent with mononuclear megakaryocytes
Megakaryocyte nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, relatively immature for the cytoplasmic volume
Surrounding blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and visible nucleoli, including one with nuclear vacuolation/pseudo-inclusion
Scattered granulocytic precursors and dense erythroid cells
Fat vacuoles and red cells in a cellular particle area
63282.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (high power) from a cellular particle shows two large megakaryocytes with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and single large, round, non-lobated nuclei (arrow), consistent with dysplastic mononuclear megakaryocytes. The surrounding cells include numerous blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli, one showing a nuclear vacuole, together with scattered granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Findings demonstrate megakaryocytic dysplasia in a blast-rich marrow, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes in 5q- syndrome (MDS with isolated del(5q))
ddx.vs: del(5q) megakaryocytes are also small with non-lobated nuclei, but occur without blast excess and with isolated del(5q) on karyotype.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes in CML or other MPN
ddx.vs: CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf) with myeloid hyperplasia and basophilia but no blast excess, and are BCR::ABL1-positive.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale hof distant from the nucleus and plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin, rather than abundant granular megakaryocytic cytoplasm.

63026.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片中，巨核細胞明顯增多，大小不一，部分核葉分離或分葉過少，切片中成簇分布並有類似 MPN 的大型分葉巨核細胞；這些巨核細胞異常加上臨床持續單核球增多，提示 MDS/MPN 範疇，而非單純反應性變化。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with increased megakaryocytes of variable size (A)
Dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes and hypolobated forms (B, C)
Background granulocytic and erythroid precursors without obvious blast excess in these fields
Trephine biopsy: hypercellular marrow with increased, loosely clustered megakaryocytes, some large with hyperlobated nuclei (D)
Monocytosis itself is not clearly demonstrated in these marrow images
63026.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate smears (A-C, Wright-Giemsa) and trephine biopsy (D, H&E). The aspirate is hypercellular with increased megakaryocytes showing marked variation in size, including forms with separated nuclear lobes and hypolobated nuclei. The biopsy is hypercellular with increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters, including large hyperlobated MPN-like forms, between adipocytes and bony trabeculae. Blasts do not appear increased in these fields, and the monocytic component cannot be quantified from the images. Combined with persistent monocytosis, del(20q) and CALR mutation, the findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm, unclassifiable.

ddx.vs: CMML requires monocytes of at least 0.5 x 10^9/L and 10% of WBC with typical granulocytic dysplasia, and CALR mutations are rare, whereas this case is classified as MDS/MPN-U.
A CALR-mutated MPN lacks dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated or hypolobated nuclei and other dysplastic features; monocytosis may occur but should prompt exclusion of MDS/MPN.
MDS shows cytopenias with dysplasia but lacks myeloproliferative features such as leukocytosis, clustered hyperlobated megakaryocytes and CALR mutation.

62962.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見大型巨噬細胞，核小而偏位，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並有纖維狀條紋，呈「皺摺紙巾（wrinkled tissue paper）」外觀，與周圍紅血球和小型造血細胞相比大小懸殊，是典型的 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Very large macrophages, many times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Small, round to oval, eccentrically placed nucleus with coarse chromatin
Abundant pale blue-gray to pinkish cytoplasm with fibrillary striations (wrinkled tissue paper / crumpled silk appearance)
Occasional clustering of several Gaucher cells
Background erythroid precursors and red cells without prominent abnormality
62962.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large macrophages with small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fibrillary, striated wrinkled tissue paper appearance. The cells occur singly and in small groups among erythroid precursors and red cells. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; in a child with massive splenomegaly and cytopenias this supports Gaucher disease, which must be confirmed by deficient beta-glucocerebrosidase activity or GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, MAC infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look nearly identical but occur with an underlying neoplasm or infection and have normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have foamy, finely vacuolated (bubbly) cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain coarse blue-green ceroid granules rather than a striated tissue-paper cytoplasm.

62898.recognize_zh: 一個分葉核嗜中性球的核葉下方，以一條細長的染色質絲連接一個小而圓、緻密的球狀附屬物（bulbous nuclear appendage）；外觀類似鼓槌（drumstick），但此例為核型正常的男性，屬於正常變異。
features: Mature neutrophil with segmented nucleus and fine pink-lilac cytoplasmic granules
Small round, densely staining nuclear appendage attached to a lobe by a thin chromatin strand
Appendage approximately 1.5 µm, drumstick-like in shape
No hypersegmentation, toxic granulation, or Döhle bodies
Background red cells with numerous crenated forms (echinocytes, likely artifactual) and scattered platelets
62898.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a segmented nucleus and normal cytoplasmic granulation. A small, round, densely staining nuclear appendage is attached to one lobe by a thin chromatin strand, resembling a drumstick. There is no hypersegmentation, toxic change, or other nuclear abnormality in this cell, and the background red cells show crenation likely related to smear preparation. In a healthy male with a normal karyotype, the finding represents a bulbous nuclear appendage of no pathologic significance.

ddx.vs: Drumsticks appear in about 1 to 3% of neutrophils in females or males with extra X chromosomes; they cannot be separated reliably from this appendage by morphology alone, so karyotype/sex context is needed.
Shows six or more lobes or many neutrophils with five lobes, rather than one small pedunculated appendage.
Sessile nodules sit directly on the lobe without a stalk, and small clubs lack the dense round head of a drumstick-like appendage.
Dysplastic neutrophils show other abnormalities such as hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger forms and fragments are unattached.

62834.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，一條粗骨小樑內有兩個被蝕骨細胞整圈包圍的圓形吸收腔（Howship's lacunae），骨小樑邊緣有淡粉紅、疏鬆的旁小樑纖維組織，周圍骨髓仍有脂肪與造血細胞，是腎性骨病變／副甲狀腺亢進的低倍特徵。
features: Low-power H&E trephine with several thick, irregular bony trabeculae
Two intratrabecular resorption cavities lined circumferentially by multinucleated osteoclasts
Resorption cavities filled with pale loose fibrous stroma
Paratrabecular bands of loose fibrous tissue with spindle cells separating bone from hematopoietic marrow
Intervening marrow shows fat spaces and trilineage hematopoietic cells
Focal basophilic smudge within a trabecula, likely cement line/decalcification artifact
62834.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow trephine shows thickened, irregular bony trabeculae containing two intratrabecular resorption cavities lined by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts and filled with loose fibrous tissue. Paratrabecular fibrosis with spindle cells is present along trabecular surfaces, while the intervening marrow retains fat and hematopoietic elements. These features reflect increased osteoclastic bone resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis. In the setting of chronic renal failure and hypocalcemia, findings are consistent with renal osteodystrophy with secondary hyperparathyroidism.

ddx.vs: Bone changes are identical and are separated by biochemistry (hypercalcemia in primary disease versus hypocalcemia and renal failure in secondary).
PMF shows diffuse marrow fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis rather than osteoclast-rich resorption cavities with paratrabecular fibrosis.
Paget disease has a mosaic pattern of cement lines and very large osteoclasts with many nuclei, with fibrovascular marrow, rather than tunnelling resorption.
Mastocytosis produces paratrabecular fibrotic lesions composed of spindled CD117/tryptase-positive mast cells, often with eosinophils, rather than osteoclast-lined cavities.

62770.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內有大片胞質空泡化、泡沫狀的組織球（CD68 陽性），傳統抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）為陰性，但改良染色可在空泡內看到大量紅色桿菌團，提示弱抗酸性分枝桿菌（如需 Fite 染色才能顯示者）感染。
features: Lymph node partially replaced by sheets of histiocytes with large clear to foamy cytoplasmic vacuoles (H&E)
Vacuolated histiocytes form CD68-positive clusters and sheets (IHC)
Conventional Ziehl-Neelsen AFB stain negative in the lesion despite a positive control (inset)
Modified stain shows abundant red rod-shaped bacilli packed within histiocyte vacuoles (inset, panel D)
No well-formed epithelioid granulomas or caseous necrosis in the fields shown
62770.describe_en: Lymph node sections show sheets of histiocytes with abundant foamy and large clear vacuolated cytoplasm interspersed among lymphocytes, without well-formed granulomas or caseous necrosis in the fields shown. The histiocytes are highlighted by CD68 immunostaining. A conventional Ziehl-Neelsen acid-fast stain is negative in the lesion while the control is positive, but a modified stain (panel D) demonstrates numerous red rod-shaped bacilli clustered within histiocyte vacuoles; the exact special stain used cannot be confirmed from the image alone. Findings are suggestive of infection by a weakly acid-fast mycobacterium (for example, Mycobacterium leprae or a nontuberculous species), and culture or PCR-based speciation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Whipple bacilli fill foamy macrophages that are strongly PAS-positive (diastase-resistant) and acid-fast negative, requiring PCR or IHC for T. whipplei to exclude.
MAC produces similar foamy histiocytes stuffed with bacilli but these are usually strongly Ziehl-Neelsen positive, unlike this ZN-negative case.
Histoplasma yeasts are small oval GMS/PAS-positive organisms with a halo, not red rods on acid-fast staining.

ddx.dx: Lipid storage disease or lipogranulomatous lymphadenopathy
ddx.vs: Storage cells and lipogranulomas contain lipid vacuoles without microorganisms on special stains.

62770.stain: H&E; IHC: CD68; Ziehl-Neelsen; modified AFB

62706.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多個中到大型原始細胞，核質比高、核圓形、染色質細緻，胞質深藍色並常有一側較淡的核周區域，未見 Auer 小體或顆粒；單看型態無法判定系別，需靠流式確認為 B/骨髓系混合表型急性白血病。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant to moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, often with a paler perinuclear or polar zone
No visible cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells with occasional echinocytes (crenated forms); no platelets evident in this field
62706.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and scant to moderate deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Background red cells show occasional crenated forms. The blasts are morphologically undifferentiated and lineage cannot be assigned on morphology alone; in conjunction with flow cytometry the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable; B-ALL lacks MPO expression or monocytic differentiation by flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar agranular blasts, but separation requires demonstrating absence of B-lineage commitment (strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10).
Monoblasts have more abundant, often vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei with prominent nucleoli, and are nonspecific esterase positive.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or activated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more mature, clumped chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, rather than fine blast chromatin.

62642.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀的設門圖（gating plot）：以 CD64 對側向散射（SS INT）將白血球分成顆粒球、單核球、淋巴球三群，是後續用 FLAER 評估 PNH 克隆的前置步驟。
features: Dot plot of CD64-PC5 (x, log) versus side scatter intensity (y, linear) on singlet events
Granulocyte gate (blue): high side scatter, dim/low CD64
Monocyte gate (red): intermediate side scatter, bright CD64 (~10^1 decade)
Lymphocyte gate (dark green): low side scatter, CD64-negative
Granulocytes are the dominant population; scattered ungated events (light green) and debris near the origin
62642.describe_en: Flow cytometric gating plot of peripheral blood singlets displayed as CD64 versus side scatter. Granulocytes (high side scatter, CD64 dim), monocytes (intermediate side scatter, CD64 bright) and lymphocytes (low side scatter, CD64 negative) are cleanly separated and gated. This plot is not diagnostic in itself; it defines the granulocyte and monocyte populations on which GPI-linked markers (FLAER, CD24, CD14) are subsequently assessed for a PNH clone, per high-sensitivity PNH testing guidelines.

62578.recognize_zh: KSHV（HHV8 LANA-1）免疫染色：淋巴結濾泡生發中心內成群的大型漿母細胞樣細胞呈強的核（部分合併細胞質）陽性，周圍小淋巴球陰性；陽性細胞侷限於生發中心分布，是 HHV8 陽性親生發中心淋巴增生性疾病（germinotropic LPD）的特徵。
features: Strong HHV8 LANA-1 staining in clusters of large plasmablastic cells
Positive cells are aggregated within and partly replacing germinal centers (germinotropic distribution)
Staining predominantly nuclear with some cytoplasmic blush
Surrounding small lymphocytes of mantle zone and interfollicular areas are negative
Large positive cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei
62578.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for KSHV/HHV8 LANA-1 shows strong staining in clusters of large plasmablastic cells that aggregate within germinal centers, partially replacing them, while the surrounding small mantle zone and interfollicular lymphocytes are negative. The positive cells are confined to follicular compartments rather than forming sheets effacing the node. This germinal-center-restricted distribution of HHV8-positive plasmablasts, combined with EBER co-positivity and lack of B-cell antigens, is consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: In HHV8+ MCD the LANA-1+ plasmablasts are scattered singly in the mantle zones of regressed follicles, are EBV negative and IgM-lambda restricted, rather than forming germinal-center aggregates.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8+ DLBCL forms confluent sheets of LANA-1+ plasmablasts effacing the architecture and is typically EBV negative.
Extracavitary PEL shows sheets of pleomorphic HHV8+/EBV+ cells infiltrating sinuses and paracortex, not confined to germinal centers, often in HIV-positive patients.

62514.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，已先圈選 CD19+ B 細胞：單一大族群 CD20 表現約在 10^4–10^5，CD38 從陰性延伸到約 10^4，呈異質性部分陽性，用來評估 CLL 的 CD38 預後標記。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on CD19-positive B cells, CD20-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD38-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Single dominant B-cell cluster with CD20 expression spanning roughly 10^4 to 10^5 (dim-to-moderate, relatively homogeneous)
CD38 expression heterogeneous, ranging from negative (<10^3) up to about 10^4-10^5, with a substantial fraction above the negative region
No discrete second B-cell population
62514.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on CD19-positive B cells displays CD20 versus CD38. The B cells form a single dominant population with dim-to-moderate CD20 and a continuous, heterogeneous CD38 expression spanning negative to positive intensities, so that a considerable proportion of the clone appears CD38 positive. The exact percentage cannot be read from the plot without quadrant statistics. In the setting of CLL, CD38 positivity in at least 30% of the clone is an adverse prognostic marker, and brighter CD20 is often seen in CLL with trisomy 12.

62450.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖：7 號只剩一條正常染色體，另一條 7 號與 12 號形成雙著絲點 dic(7;12)（排在 12 號位置），9 號與 22 號各有一條衍生染色體（t(9;22)，22 號上較小的即 Ph 染色體），性染色體為 XX，總數 45 條。
features: GTG-banded karyotype arranged in standard order, two X chromosomes and no Y
Only one normal chromosome 7 in its position
Abnormal dicentric chromosome placed with pair 12, labeled dic(7;12)(p13;p11.2), composed of 7 and 12 material
Derivative chromosome 9 with extra material at 9q and a shortened chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome), labeled t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
Modal count 45 due to the dicentric fusion of two chromosomes
Non-morphologic cytogenetic image; banding resolution is moderate
62450.describe_en: GTG-banded karyotype shows a female chromosome complement with 45 chromosomes. There is a reciprocal translocation between chromosomes 9 and 22 producing a derivative chromosome 9 and a small Philadelphia chromosome, and a dicentric chromosome formed from chromosomes 7 and 12, accounting for the loss of one normal chromosome 7 and one normal chromosome 12 from the count. The karyotype is described as 45,XX,dic(7;12)(p13;p11.2),t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). The t(9;22) establishes a BCR::ABL1 rearrangement, and the additional dic(7;12) represents a secondary clonal abnormality that should be correlated with FISH and the clinical phase of disease.

ddx.vs: True monosomy 7 shows a single chromosome 7 without any 7-derived material elsewhere, whereas here 7p-7q material is retained within the dic(7;12), as confirmed by FISH.
Variant or cryptic rearrangements may lack a visible Ph chromosome and require FISH or RT-PCR, whereas a classic t(9;22) is visible here.
A simple 12p deletion would not alter the chromosome count or include chromosome 7 material, unlike the dicentric seen here.

62386.recognize_zh: 高倍下左側是淡粉紅、細顆粒狀的壞死區，右側交界處有大量深染的點狀核碎屑，混雜細胞質豐富、核淡染的組織球與少數漿細胞樣細胞；壞死邊緣的核碎屑與組織球反應，需鑑別菊池病、感染或狼瘡相關淋巴結炎。
features: Pale eosinophilic granular necrosis on one side of the field
Abundant dark karyorrhectic nuclear debris at the edge of necrosis
Histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei
Scattered plasmacytoid cells and small lymphocytes
Neutrophils and well-formed granulomas not evident in this field
62386.describe_en: High-power view shows an area of pale eosinophilic granular necrosis bordered by abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris. The viable edge contains histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei, admixed with scattered plasmacytoid cells and small lymphocytes. Neutrophilic abscesses and well-formed epithelioid granulomas are not identified in this field. The findings represent a necrotizing lymphadenitis with histiocytic reaction; differential considerations include Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease, lupus lymphadenitis and infection, and special stains and cultures are recommended.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi disease shows similar karyorrhexis with crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells but characteristically lacks neutrophils and plasma cells are sparse.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial or fungal necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis
ddx.vs: Infectious granulomatous processes show palisading epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells around caseous necrosis, with organisms on AFB/GMS stains.
Lupus may show hematoxylin bodies and more plasma cells, and requires ANA/anti-dsDNA correlation.

62322.recognize_zh: 單顆中型母細胞，核圓形略有凹陷、染色質細緻，細胞質中等量呈淡灰藍色，核旁可見一顆小的嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granule）；這種型態本身不具特異性，須配合 CD123、CD4、CD56、TCF4 等標記才能診斷母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Medium-sized blast about 1.5 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Moderately high N:C ratio with a round nucleus showing a shallow indentation at the lower left
Fine, slightly granular chromatin without a conspicuous nucleolus
Moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Single small dark azurophilic granule adjacent to the nuclear indentation
No Auer rods, vacuoles or pseudopod-like projections in this cell
62322.describe_en: High-power view of the aspirate smear shows a medium-sized blast with a moderately high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a round nucleus with a shallow indentation and fine chromatin, and moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm. A single small azurophilic granule is present next to the nuclear indentation. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic vacuoles are identified. The morphology is that of a nonspecific blast with rare granulation; in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+, TCL1+, MPO-negative), findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation or monocytic AML
ddx.vs: Occasional azurophilic granules do not establish myeloid lineage; AML is MPO-positive or expresses CD13/CD33/CD117/CD14 and lacks the CD123bright/TCF4/TCL1 plasmacytoid dendritic cell profile.
Lymphoblasts look similar but express TdT and CD19/CD79a or cytoplasmic CD3, and are CD123/CD56/CD4-negative.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: MPDCP cells are more mature and CD56-negative, occurring with CMML/MDS, rather than CD56-positive blasts.

62130.recognize_zh: 淋巴結高倍視野中央有一團密集的嗜酸性球，胞質鮮紅、核雙葉，形成嗜酸性微膿瘍（eosinophilic microabscess），周圍為組織球、內皮細胞與淋巴球，是 Kimura 病的重要線索。
features: Dense central aggregate of eosinophils with bright red granular cytoplasm and bilobed nuclei
Eosinophilic granular debris between cells consistent with eosinophil degranulation
Surrounding epithelioid histiocytes and plump endothelial cells of small vessels
Background of small lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells in the interfollicular area
Fine brown pigment granules scattered at the periphery; no atypical large cells
62130.describe_en: Lymph node section shows an interfollicular area containing a dense collection of eosinophils with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and bilobed nuclei, forming an eosinophilic microabscess with granular debris. The aggregate is surrounded by histiocytes, plump endothelial cells, small lymphocytes and plasma cells. No Reed-Sternberg-like cells, Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei, or necrotizing vasculitis is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with an eosinophilic microabscess, supporting Kimura disease in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: cHL can be eosinophil rich but contains CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, which are absent here.
LCH shows eosinophil abscesses with sinusoidal Langerhans cells having grooved nuclei that are CD1a/langerin positive.
These show eosinophilic infiltrates without germinal center IgE deposits and folliculolysis, and correlate with exposure history or parasite identification.
Clonal eosinophilic disorders show marrow and blood involvement with tyrosine kinase gene rearrangements rather than a localized reactive nodal process.

62066.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色下，藍色背景的梭形細胞與基質之間可見兩條呈棕色、細長捲曲的螺旋狀菌體，這就是梅毒螺旋體（Treponema pallidum）陽性染色，支持梅毒性淋巴結炎。
features: Thin, tightly coiled, wavy brown-staining filamentous organisms (spirochetes) on immunostain
Organisms located in the stroma/around spindle cells and vessel-like spaces rather than within lymphoid follicles in this field
Hematoxylin-counterstained oval to spindle nuclei of stromal/endothelial cells and histiocytes
Sparse organisms (two in this field) with clean, non-specific-staining-free background
62066.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Treponema pallidum shows scattered thin, wavy, coiled brown-staining spirochetes within the fibrous stroma among spindle-shaped stromal and endothelial cells. Organisms are sparse, with two readily identified in this high-power field, and there is no significant background staining. The morphology of the stained structures is characteristic of spirochetes rather than non-specific fibers. Findings are consistent with syphilitic (luetic) lymphadenitis; correlation with serology (RPR/VDRL and treponemal tests) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Non-specific staining of collagen or reticulin fibers
ddx.vs: Fibers are straight or gently curved and stain uniformly, whereas spirochetes show regular tight corkscrew coils of uniform thickness.
Borrelia is also spiral but more loosely coiled and cross-reacts variably; clinical history and species-specific serology or PCR are needed.
Brachyspira forms a fringe on colonic surface epithelium and is not seen within lymph node stroma.

62002.recognize_zh: H&E 下可見整片小到中型圓形細胞，細胞核圓、偏心、染色質粗塊，並帶少量雙染性細胞質，呈淋巴漿細胞樣（lymphoplasmacytoid）外觀；這種「小而成熟」的形態是 t(11;14) 骨髓瘤常見的樣貌，但 cyclin D1 需以免疫染色確認。
features: Diffuse sheet of small to medium-sized, monotonous round cells
Round, often eccentric nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm giving a lymphoplasmacytoid appearance
No residual fat or trilineage hematopoiesis in this field
Right half shows a looser area with vacuolated, edematous stroma and extravasated red cells
Small vessel at upper left; no Dutcher bodies or amyloid clearly identified
62002.describe_en: H&E section shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of small to medium-sized, monotonous round cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, imparting a lymphoplasmacytoid appearance. No residual hematopoietic elements are seen in this field, and the right side shows looser, edematous stroma with scattered red cells. The small, mature, lymphoplasmacytoid morphology is characteristic of myeloma with t(11;14). Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm; immunohistochemistry (CD138, light chains, cyclin D1) and FISH are required to confirm the cyclin D1-expressing subtype.

ddx.vs: LPL is a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a CD20+/PAX5+ B-cell component and MYD88 L265P, whereas t(11;14) myeloma is a monotypic CD138+ population, often CD20+ but PAX5-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells have irregular nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are CD5+/SOX11+/CD138-negative, in contrast to CD138+ plasma cells with light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma shows a predominant CD20+ monocytoid/centrocyte-like B-cell component with plasma cells as a minor subset, and lacks cyclin D1.

61938.recognize_zh: 低倍下一個巨大的結節幾乎佔滿整個視野，以深染的小淋巴球為主，中央夾雜淡染、界線不清的生發中心殘塊，外套區與生發中心分界消失，是進行性生發中心轉化（PTGC）的特徵。
features: Single very large nodule occupying most of the field
Predominance of small dark lymphocytes infiltrating the nodule center
Pale, ill-defined fragments of residual germinal center within the nodule
Loss of a distinct mantle zone/germinal center interface
Thin capsule-like fibrous rim and adjacent lymphoid tissue at the edges
61938.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a very large nodule composed predominantly of small lymphocytes, with pale, poorly delineated residual germinal center fragments dispersed within it and loss of the normal mantle-germinal center interface. No large atypical cells are identifiable at this magnification, although cytologic detail is limited. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers; IgD highlights the mantle-cell infiltration, and absence of LP cells should be confirmed to exclude NLPHL.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows multiple large nodules replacing the node with scattered LP cells (CD20+, EMA+/-, CD15-/CD30-) rosetted by PD1+ T cells.
Floral FL has monotonous neoplastic follicles with BCL2+/CD10+ germinal center cells and light-chain restriction, unlike reactive PTGC.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows monocytoid/marginal zone B cells colonizing follicles, often IgD-negative and with plasmacytic differentiation, rather than IgD+ mantle cells.

61874.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見成群的中型原始細胞，胞質深藍並帶有明顯的空泡，外觀很像 Burkitt 淋巴瘤（L3 型）；但確診為 T 淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（T-ALL/LBL）需要流式細胞儀，形態不能單獨區分。
features: Numerous clusters and loose sheets of medium-sized blasts among red cells
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and dense-appearing chromatin at low power
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent small punched-out vacuoles
Smudged/disrupted cells in the background
Few residual normal granulocytes
61874.describe_en: Low-power view of a smear, probably a bone marrow aspirate, shows numerous clusters and loose sheets of medium-sized blasts scattered among red cells. The blasts have high nucleus-to-cytoplasm ratios, round nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing prominent small vacuoles, closely resembling Burkitt-type (L3) morphology. Occasional smudged cells are present and residual normal hematopoietic cells are sparse. Morphology alone cannot distinguish this from Burkitt lymphoma; immunophenotyping is required, and in this case flow cytometry established a diagnosis of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are mature B cells (CD19, CD20, CD10, surface light-chain restricted, TdT negative) with MYC rearrangement, whereas these blasts lack B and myeloid markers and express T-lineage markers.
B-ALL blasts express CD19, CD22, cytoplasmic CD79a and often CD10/TdT, whereas these blasts are negative for B-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and express CD33, CD13, CD64 and CD11b, which are negative here.
Megakaryoblasts can show basophilic cytoplasm with blebs but express CD41/CD61 and are not vacuolated in the Burkitt pattern.

61810.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下幾乎全為成片的中大型未成熟細胞，核呈卵圓、摺疊或腎形，染色質細、可見小核仁，並有多個有絲分裂像，缺乏正常成熟造血細胞，提示母細胞浸潤（AML）。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate-to-large immature cells effacing normal hematopoiesis
Oval, indented to folded (monocytoid) nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic cells; interstitial red cells only
61810.describe_en: H&E-stained section at high power shows diffuse sheets of intermediate-to-large immature cells with oval, indented and folded nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic cells are readily found, and residual maturing granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia, possibly with monocytic features, in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation; immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry are needed for confirmation and lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5-positive and lack myeloid markers, whereas these blasts would express CD33/MPO or monocytic markers.
Identical cytology but defined by an extramedullary tumor mass, so distinction depends on the anatomic site rather than morphology.
BPDCN cells co-express CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 without MPO or lysozyme.

61746.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見成片的大型非典型淋巴細胞，核呈泡狀、核仁明顯，並有分裂象，夾雜小淋巴球與漿細胞；大型細胞比例高，對應高級別（grade 3）淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的外觀。
features: Numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli
Irregular, occasionally multilobated nuclei; a mitotic figure is present
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm in the large cells
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells in a polymorphous background
Fibrinous/eosinophilic stroma between cells
61746.describe_en: Sections show a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate dominated by large atypical cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli, irregular nuclear contours, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic activity is present, and small lymphocytes and plasma cells are admixed. Angiocentricity and necrosis are not evaluable in this high-power field. In conjunction with CD20 and EBER staining, findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis with a high proportion of large cells (grade 3 pattern).

ddx.vs: Cytology overlaps with grade 3 LYG; the distinction relies on angiocentric-angiodestructive growth, necrosis, a T-cell-rich background, and EBER positivity in LYG.
HRS cells in CHL are CD30/CD15-positive with weak PAX5 and absent CD20/CD45, unlike the CD20-positive large B cells of LYG.
ALCL cells are uniformly strong CD30-positive T/null cells with hallmark horseshoe nuclei and lack CD20 and EBER.

61682.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（側散射 SS 對 CD3，活細胞閘門），非形態影像；低側散射、CD3 陽性的藍色族群佔活細胞 76.95%，代表明顯擴增的 T 細胞族群，灰色高側散射的是 CD3 陰性的顆粒球。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis, log) versus side scatter intensity (y-axis, linear), gated on [Living Cells]
Boxed region of low side scatter CD3-positive events annotated CD3+ : 76.95%
Dominant blue CD3-positive population with low side scatter, with red and magenta subsets inside the gate
Grey CD3-negative high side scatter events consistent with granulocytes, plus intermediate side scatter events consistent with monocytes
Green CD3-negative low side scatter lymphoid events (non-T lymphocytes)
61682.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of viable cells displays CD3 versus side scatter. A large low side scatter, CD3-positive population comprises 76.95% of the annotated events, indicating a marked T-lymphocytosis relative to CD3-negative granulocytes (high side scatter), monocytes and non-T lymphocytes. A grey CD3-positive streak extending to higher side scatter likely represents a separate or artifactual population and is not further characterized here. An expanded mature T-cell population of this size supports the given diagnosis of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, which requires further antigen profiling (CD4/CD8, CD7, TCL1) for classification.

61618.recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩個嗜中性球核分葉減少（雙葉或近雙葉），左側細胞還有兩個小型核突起，呈假性 Pelger-Huët 樣異常；但本圖未見芽細胞，無法單獨診斷 AML。
features: Two neutrophils with hypolobated (bilobed) nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Left neutrophil with two small nuclear appendages (drumstick/knob-like projections)
Cytoplasm with fine granules, not clearly hypogranular
Red cells with crenation (echinocytes, likely artifact) and platelets present
No blasts visible in this field
61618.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hypolobated, bilobed nuclei and coarsely condensed chromatin, one bearing small nuclear appendages, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët-like change. Cytoplasmic granulation appears preserved. Red cells show crenation, likely a drying artifact, and platelets are present. No circulating blasts are identified in this field; the image demonstrates neutrophil nuclear abnormalities only and is not by itself diagnostic of AML with mutated CEBPA.

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger change is patchy and accompanies a myeloid neoplasm.
Agents such as mycophenolate, taxanes, or valproate can produce identical hypolobation; drug history and resolution after withdrawal distinguish.
Bands have a continuous curved nucleus without the discrete bilobed spectacle-like configuration and coarse chromatin clumping.

61554.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 CD10 免疫染色低倍下，淋巴結整體架構保存，只有左上少數幾個生發中心內出現強陽性、偏向濾泡周邊分布的 CD10+ B 細胞，其他濾泡僅淡染、濾泡間無浸潤；這種侷限於生發中心的強 CD10 型態提示原位濾泡性腫瘤（ISFN）。
features: Low-power lymph node with preserved architecture and multiple scattered follicles
A few follicles (upper left) contain strongly CD10-positive cells, accentuated at the periphery of the germinal centers
Most other germinal centers show only weak, background-level CD10 staining
No CD10-positive cells spilling into the interfollicular areas beyond scattered single positive cells
Mantle zones appear preserved around involved follicles
61554.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD10 on an excisional lymph node biopsy shows preserved nodal architecture with numerous scattered follicles. A few follicles, predominantly at the upper left, contain strongly CD10-positive cells that are accentuated at the periphery of the germinal centers, in contrast to the weaker staining of the remaining germinal centers. There is no significant interfollicular infiltration by CD10-positive cells, and mantle zones appear preserved. In combination with strong BCL2 coexpression in the same germinal centers, the pattern is most consistent with in situ follicular B-cell neoplasm (in situ follicular neoplasia).

ddx.dx: Partial nodal involvement by follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Involved follicles are more numerous and expanded with attenuated mantles, often with interfollicular CD10+/BCL2+ cells, rather than a few normal-sized follicles with isolated strongly positive germinal centers.
Germinal centers show uniform moderate CD10 and are BCL2-negative, without a subset of intensely CD10+/BCL2+ cells.
Cyclin D1-positive cells are confined to the inner mantle zone and are CD10-negative.

61426.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨噬細胞的胞質內塞滿數十個小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies，無鞭毛體 amastigote），周圍為正常造血細胞，符合利什曼原蟲感染（內臟利什曼病）。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm packed with numerous small (about 2-4 um) oval purple bodies
Organisms are uniform, some showing a tiny paired dot suggestive of nucleus and kinetoplast (limited resolution)
A few organisms scattered at the edge of the macrophage, likely from cell disruption
Background of maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Red cells without intraerythrocytic parasites
61426.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular organisms, with a few extending beyond the cell border. At this magnification a nucleus and adjacent rod-like kinetoplast are only faintly discernible. The surrounding marrow shows maturing myeloid and erythroid elements without other abnormalities in this field. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (Leishmania amastigotes), supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo around a crescent of stained cytoplasm and lack a kinetoplast; they are GMS/PAS-positive whereas Leishmania is not.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Platelets are granular, irregular and not uniformly contained within cytoplasm, and lack the nucleus-kinetoplast pair.

61362.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的骨髓被腫瘤取代，可見成群的大型細胞具豐富嗜雙色細胞質、偏心泡狀核與明顯核仁，部分為雙核，外觀似神經節細胞，背景為淡粉紅纖維狀基質，符合伴有神經節分化的轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Marrow space between trabeculae replaced by a tumor infiltrate within a pale fibrillary (neuropil-like/schwannian) stroma
Clusters of large ganglion-like cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round vesicular nuclei with prominent single nucleoli; occasional binucleate cells
Intermixed smaller cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and spindle stromal cells
Absence of normal hematopoiesis in the involved area; interstitial hemorrhage and bony trabeculae at edges
61362.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows intertrabecular replacement by a tumor composed of clusters of large ganglion-like cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, some binucleate, set in a pale fibrillary stroma with admixed smaller hyperchromatic cells. Normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in the involved area. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastic tumor with ganglionic differentiation (differentiating neuroblastoma or ganglioneuroblastoma), to be confirmed by PHOX2B, PGP9.5 and synaptophysin immunostains with correlation to urine catecholamines and imaging.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive glands or nests in desmoplastic stroma and are cytokeratin positive, lacking neuropil and PHOX2B expression.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei without prominent single nucleoli and are scattered among hematopoietic cells rather than clustered in fibrillary stroma.
Rhabdomyoblasts have eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm too, but express desmin and myogenin rather than neural markers.
