ddx.dx: Osteoblasts / osteoclasts in a remodeling marrow
ddx.vs: Osteoblasts line trabecular surfaces with a perinuclear hof and osteoclasts are multinucleated, not forming clusters within neuropil-like stroma.

61298.recognize_zh: CD61 染色讓巨核細胞呈強烈棕色，細胞大小不一且成群聚集，核呈球根狀、雲朵狀分葉並深染，另見散在小型陽性碎片；這種群聚且型態異常的巨核細胞符合骨髓增殖性腫瘤纖維化期。
features: Strong cytoplasmic CD61 staining in megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes clustered in loose and tight aggregates, variable in size
Nuclei hyperlobated to bulbous, cloud-like, some hyperchromatic
Scattered small CD61-positive cells/fragments and platelets
Background CD61-negative hematopoietic cells, adipocytes, and a streaming stromal area at right
61298.describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights increased megakaryocytes forming loose and tight clusters. The megakaryocytes vary in size and have hyperlobated, bulbous or cloud-like nuclei, some hyperchromatic, with strong cytoplasmic staining; scattered small CD61-positive cells and platelet fragments are also present. The background includes CD61-negative hematopoietic cells, adipocytes, and a streaming stromal area suggestive of fibrosis. In the setting of polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis, to be correlated with reticulin staining.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes look the same at the fibrotic stage, so the distinction relies on documented prior PV and clinical history.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated, or micromegakaryocytes rather than large clustered bulbous forms, and MPN driver mutations are usually absent.
Tumor cells are CD61-negative and keratin-positive, whereas these large cells are megakaryocytes confirmed by CD61.

61234.recognize_zh: 新生兒骨髓抹片兩個視野中巨核細胞非常少，出現的是體積小、核分葉少（hypolobated）或單核、細胞質深藍的未成熟巨核細胞，符合先天性無巨核細胞血小板減少症（CAMT）的骨髓表現。
features: Megakaryocytes are scant; each field contains only a single megakaryocyte amid abundant hematopoietic cells and red cells
Left field: small megakaryocyte with a hypolobated, eccentric, dense nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Right field: megakaryocyte with a single non-lobated eccentric nucleus and abundant agranular to finely granular blue cytoplasm (immature form)
Background with numerous small round nucleated cells (erythroid precursors and lymphocytes) without obvious blasts
Blood-rich smear with densely packed red cells
61234.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear from a neonate (two fields) shows markedly reduced megakaryocytes, with only rare forms identified. The megakaryocytes present are small or immature, with hypolobated or non-lobated eccentric nuclei and basophilic, poorly granular cytoplasm, indicating variable morphology and impaired maturation. The remaining hematopoietic elements appear present without an obvious blast population, although the hemodilute smear limits cellularity assessment. In the context of neonatal thrombocytopenia with a homozygous MPL mutation, findings are consistent with congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Marrow megakaryocytes are also reduced and immature, but TAR has bilateral absent radii with thumbs present and RBM8A variants rather than MPL mutations.
Marrow megakaryocytes are normal or increased due to peripheral destruction, and maternal anti-HPA antibodies are detected.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplasia/transient abnormal myelopoiesis with dysplastic micromegakaryocytes
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes occur with blasts or trisomy 21-associated GATA1 mutation, whereas CAMT shows simple megakaryocyte paucity.

61170.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區被淡染、細胞質豐富的組織球與樹突細胞擴張成淡色區，其中散布棕色的黑色素顆粒吞噬細胞（melanophage），與左側深藍色小淋巴球區形成對比，這種「淡色結節＋黑色素」是皮膚病性淋巴結炎（dermatopathic lymphadenitis）的特徵。
features: Pale-staining expansion of the paracortex (interfollicular region) contrasting with dark residual small lymphocytes
Pale zone composed of histiocytes and dendritic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, folded or grooved vesicular nuclei
Scattered macrophages containing coarse brown melanin pigment within the pale areas
Interspersed small mature lymphocytes and high endothelial venules
Fibrous capsule/trabecula at the lower right; no sheets of atypical lymphocytes seen at this power
61170.describe_en: Lymph node section shows expansion of the paracortex by pale-staining areas that contrast with residual dark zones of small lymphocytes. The pale areas are composed of histiocytes and dendritic cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and oval to grooved vesicular nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes and high endothelial venules. Numerous macrophages containing coarse brown melanin pigment are scattered within these areas. No cytologically atypical lymphoid infiltrate is appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenitis; in patients with erythroderma, T-cell clonality studies may be warranted to exclude early nodal involvement by mycosis fungoides.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sézary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes effacing the paracortex, and TCR clonality is identical to the skin clone.
LCH shows sinusoidal sheets of Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei and many eosinophils, often with necrosis, rather than paracortical nodules with melanophages.
Melanoma forms cohesive nests of atypical cells with macronucleoli and intracytoplasmic pigment, whereas here pigment is in bland macrophages.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown and refractile and Prussian blue positive, whereas melanin is finer dark brown and Fontana-Masson positive.

61106.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構大致保留，但竇（sinus）內塞滿大型多形性細胞，核大且不規則，可見免疫母細胞樣與間變樣細胞（插圖箭頭）；核染陽性的大細胞集中在竇內成團，而 B 細胞標記幾乎陰性，符合竇內型腔外原發性滲出性淋巴瘤。
features: Low power (A): lymph node with preserved lymphoid areas and distended sinuses filled by a cellular infiltrate
Medium power (B): sinuses packed with large pleomorphic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm
High power inset: immunoblastic to anaplastic cells with large irregular nuclei and prominent nucleoli (arrows)
IHC (C): strong nuclear staining of the intrasinusoidal tumor cells and cells in surrounding parenchyma
IHC (D, E): tumor cells in sinuses largely negative, with positive cells mostly in the residual lymphoid tissue (markers not labeled; consistent with loss of B-cell antigens)
61106.describe_en: Composite figure of a lymph node. At low power the architecture is partially preserved, with sinuses distended by a cellular infiltrate. At higher power the sinuses are filled by large pleomorphic cells with immunoblastic, plasmablastic and anaplastic features, including prominent nucleoli. An immunostain with nuclear localization strongly labels the intrasinusoidal tumor clusters, whereas additional markers stain mainly residual background lymphoid cells and spare the neoplastic cells. In the setting of HHV-8 nuclear positivity (LANA) and loss of B-cell antigens, findings are consistent with the intrasinusoidal pattern of extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL also favors sinuses and has hallmark cells but is a T-cell lymphoma, CD30 positive, often ALK positive, and HHV-8 negative.
Metastases form cohesive nests within sinuses and express keratin or SOX10/S100, not CD45/CD138 with HHV-8.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is typically diffuse, EBV positive and HHV-8 negative.
HHV-8+ DLBCL arises in multicentric Castleman disease, is EBV negative and expresses IgM lambda, unlike EBV-coinfected PEL.

61042.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下在小淋巴球（SLL）背景中出現多個淡染結節並在周邊融合成片，高倍可見中大型非典型淋巴球；結節內細胞 Ki-67、C-MYC、MUM1 高表現，與周圍 SLL 形成對比，符合 Richter 轉化（大 B 細胞淋巴瘤型）。
features: Low power: lymph node effaced with pale nodules centrally becoming confluent at the periphery, on a dark small-cell background
High power: sheets of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
CD20 diffusely positive; CD5 positive in the background with variable expression in the large-cell areas
CD3 highlights only scattered T cells
Ki-67, MYC and MUM1 concentrated in the nodular and subcapsular confluent large-cell areas
61042.describe_en: Composite of lymph node sections. At low power the node is effaced by a small lymphocytic infiltrate containing discrete pale nodules centrally that become confluent toward the periphery. At high power these areas are composed of sheets of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei. Immunostains show CD20 positivity, CD5 expression, sparse CD3-positive T cells, and a high Ki-67 index with MYC and MUM1 positivity concentrated in the large-cell regions, in contrast to the surrounding small lymphocytic lymphoma. Findings are consistent with Richter transformation of CLL/SLL to large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: CLL/SLL with expanded proliferation centers (accelerated phase)
ddx.vs: Proliferation centers contain prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts that do not form confluent sheets of large cells, and are smaller than a 20x field.
Hodgkin-type RT has scattered CD30+/CD15+, CD20-negative Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background rather than sheets of CD20+ large B cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive keratinizing nests positive for cytokeratin/p40 and negative for CD20.

61042.stain: H&E, IHC: CD20, CD5, CD3, Ki-67, MYC, MUM1

60978.recognize_zh: 一群退化的嗜中性球，細胞質嚴重空泡化，內含大量細小、深藍色的短棒狀細菌，部分菌體位於空泡內，符合周邊血中嗜中性球吞噬細菌（細胞內細菌），提示嚴重菌血症。
features: Cluster of degenerating neutrophils with pyknotic, smudged magenta nuclear fragments
Extensive cytoplasmic vacuolization with a foamy appearance
Numerous small, uniform, dark blue rod-shaped bacteria within the vacuolated cytoplasm
Occasional organisms lying just outside cell borders
Background red cells without specific abnormality
60978.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of degenerating neutrophils with smudged, fragmented nuclei and markedly vacuolated, foamy cytoplasm containing numerous small, uniform, rod-shaped basophilic bacteria. A few organisms lie adjacent to the cells. The accompanying red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with intracellular (phagocytosed) bacteria in circulating neutrophils, indicating high-grade bacteremia; Gram stain and blood culture are needed for identification.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, dark, evenly distributed round granules, not discrete elongated rod-shaped organisms within vacuoles.
Morulae form a single compact mulberry-like cluster within one vacuole rather than countless scattered bacilli throughout foamy cytoplasm.
Yeasts are larger oval forms with a clear halo, not tiny slender rods.

ddx.dx: Ex vivo overgrowth in delayed/stored specimen
ddx.vs: Bacterial proliferation in an aged tube can mimic this; correlation with prompt smear preparation and positive blood cultures is required.

60914.recognize_zh: 抹片中巨噬細胞吞噬多顆完整的有核細胞（含嗜中性球與紅血球前驅細胞），即噬血現象；另見紅系前驅細胞核呈多分葉、碎裂等造血異常；切片高細胞密度並有大量核碎屑，符合反應性噬血性淋巴組織球增生症造成的紅系造血異常。
features: Biopsy: hypercellular marrow with abundant karyorrhectic/apoptotic nuclear debris and histiocytes
Aspirate: macrophage containing several engulfed intact nucleated cells (hemophagocytosis)
Erythroid precursors with multilobated, budding or fragmented nuclei (dyserythropoiesis)
Large basophilic erythroblast with megaloblastoid chromatin
Accompanying eosinophils and granulocytes; disrupted granular cells in background
60914.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine is hypercellular with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris and scattered histiocytes. The aspirate shows macrophages containing multiple intact engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Erythroid precursors show dyserythropoietic changes including nuclear lobulation, budding and fragmentation, together with megaloblastoid early erythroblasts; eosinophils and granulocytes are also present. In the setting of fulfilled clinical HLH criteria, findings are consistent with reactive hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis with secondary dyserythropoiesis; an underlying infection or lymphoma should be sought before attributing dysplasia to myelodysplasia.

ddx.vs: MDS shows persistent multilineage dysplasia with clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities, without prominent hemophagocytosis and clinical HLH criteria.
Requires identification of an atypical lymphoid infiltrate by IHC or flow cytometry, which is not evident in these fields.
Megaloblastic change is uniform with giant metamyelocytes and low B12/folate but lacks hemophagocytic macrophages.
Isolated macrophages ingesting mature red cells is nonspecific, whereas HLH shows engulfment of nucleated cells with fever, cytopenias and hyperferritinemia.

60850.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見成片的中型至大型細胞，胞質淡嗜酸性且邊界不清，細胞核卵圓並帶有明顯核溝、折疊或腎形凹陷（咖啡豆樣），周圍夾雜大量嗜酸性球，這是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的典型組合。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large lesional cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval to reniform nuclei with longitudinal grooves, folds and angulated indentations ('coffee-bean' nuclei), fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous admixed eosinophils with bright red granules and bilobed nuclei, concentrated at the left and upper field
Scattered small lymphocytes among the lesional cells
No significant nuclear pleomorphism or atypical mitoses
60850.describe_en: High-power hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of lymph node shows sheets of lesional cells with moderate to abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, grooved, folded or reniform nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Numerous eosinophils and scattered small lymphocytes are admixed, particularly toward the left of the field. Significant cytologic atypia is not seen. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are larger with round vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and emperipolesis, without nuclear grooves or prominent eosinophils, and are CD1a negative.
Dermatopathic lymphadenopathy forms paracortical nodules with mixed interdigitating/Langerhans cells and melanin-laden macrophages rather than sinus-filling sheets with abundant eosinophils.
Hodgkin lymphoma also has eosinophils but contains Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells with large nucleoli that are CD30/CD15 positive and CD1a negative.
These show eosinophilic microabscesses and follicular hyperplasia without sheets of grooved CD1a+ histiocytoid cells.

60786.recognize_zh: 兩顆嗜酸性球的橘紅色顆粒間夾雜大而深紫的嗜鹼性顆粒（異常嗜酸性球），旁邊有一顆高核質比、染色質細緻的芽細胞，是 inv(16) AML 的典型骨髓線索。
features: Two eosinophil-lineage cells with orange eosinophilic granules admixed with coarse dark purple-violet (basophilic-staining) granules
Abnormal eosinophils have round to indented/bilobed immature nuclei
Adjacent blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm with a small cytoplasmic bleb
Background of scattered red cells and a smeared nucleus at left; thin, somewhat debris-rich aspirate film
60786.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two eosinophilic precursors containing orange eosinophilic granules intermixed with large, dark purple basophilic-staining granules, a feature not seen in normal eosinophils. An adjacent blast has a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Only a few cells are present in this field, so blast percentage and monocytic differentiation cannot be assessed here. Findings are consistent with the abnormal eosinophils of acute myeloid leukemia with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16); CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: Mature eosinophils in reactive states have uniform orange granules without the admixed large purple basophilic granules seen here, and no increase in blasts.
CML shows a left-shifted granulocytic proliferation with separate basophils and BCR::ABL1, rather than hybrid-granule eosinophils with increased monocytic blasts.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Eosinophils may be dysplastic but rarely carry basophilic granules; the discriminator is FISH/RT-PCR showing a tyrosine kinase fusion rather than CBFB::MYH11.
Morphology can overlap, but abnormal eosinophils are lacking or scant and cytogenetics does not show inv(16)/t(16;16).

60594.recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI FLAIR 未見明顯異常，周邊血液出現少數大型異常淋巴球；骨髓切片看似造血細胞為主，但免疫染色（B 細胞標記）顯示大型陽性細胞沿著竇狀血管內呈線性排列，說明腫瘤細胞侷限在血管腔內，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Brain MRI (FLAIR, axial) without evident parenchymal signal abnormality or mass
Peripheral blood: occasional large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, fine to slightly open chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Bone marrow biopsy H&E: cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis; large atypical cells inconspicuous on H&E
Inset schematic outlines the tortuous sinusoidal distribution
IHC (B-cell marker, likely CD20): large positive cells confined to marrow sinusoids in linear/branching intravascular pattern
60594.describe_en: Axial FLAIR MRI of the brain shows no evident parenchymal abnormality. Peripheral blood smear contains occasional large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy appears relatively unremarkable on H&E, but immunohistochemistry for a B-cell marker highlights large atypical cells distributed exclusively within sinusoidal lumens in a linear, branching pattern. In a patient with rapidly progressive neurological deterioration, findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; random skin and marrow biopsies are useful diagnostic sites when imaging is unrevealing.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with marrow involvement
ddx.vs: Forms interstitial or nodular extravascular aggregates rather than cells restricted to sinusoidal lumens.
Also intrasinusoidal, but consists of small lymphocytes with low proliferation rather than large atypical B cells.
Shows the same intravascular pattern but cells are CD20 negative, CD3/CD56 positive and EBER positive.
HLH shows hemophagocytic macrophages without CD20-positive large cells in vessels, though the two may coexist.

60594.stain: MRI FLAIR; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD20 (likely)

60658.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個大型巨噬細胞的胞質內塞滿數十個小而卵圓、大小一致的微生物，各自帶有深染的核，部分可見旁邊的小點狀構造（kinetoplast），細胞外也散落相同小體，符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishmania amastigotes）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant cytoplasm distended by numerous small, uniform oval organisms
Each organism about 2-4 µm with a dark purple nucleus; a small rod-like kinetoplast is suggested but not clearly resolved at this resolution
Free extracellular organisms scattered near the macrophage and in the background
No surrounding clear capsule-like halo around the organisms
Background hematopoietic cells including myeloid precursors, a binucleate erythroid precursor, and a segmented neutrophil
60658.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous small, uniform oval intracellular organisms, each with a dark-staining nucleus; similar organisms are also present extracellularly. A second smaller paranuclear kinetoplast is suggested in some organisms, although it is not sharply resolved at this magnification. The surrounding marrow contains granulocytic and erythroid precursors without a neoplastic infiltrate. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis (Leishmania amastigotes), an unexpected cause of pancytopenia after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo (pseudocapsule) around a crescent-shaped nucleus and lack a kinetoplast; GMS/PAS stain yeast but not Leishmania.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are GMS positive, without a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no kinetoplast, and are usually in tissue cysts rather than macrophages in marrow.
Platelets and debris lack an organized nucleus-plus-kinetoplast structure and are not uniform oval bodies.

60722.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞大小與形態差異極大：有核呈花瓣狀、多葉或多核的巨大漿細胞，也有雙核與核偏位、帶細胞質空泡的漿細胞，低倍下漿細胞明顯增多，呈現骨髓瘤的「多種形態」。
features: Increased plasma cells with marked pleomorphism in cell size and nuclear configuration
Giant multinucleated/multilobated plasma cells with flower-like (cloverleaf) nuclear arrangement and abundant blue cytoplasm (C)
Binucleate and nuclei with deep clefts or segmentation (A, B), some with a distinct perinuclear hof
Chromatin ranges from coarse clockface to finely dispersed; occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles and pale inclusions
Low power (D): numerous plasma cells of variable size among residual hematopoietic cells; smear background yellowish
60722.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a marked increase in plasma cells with striking pleomorphism. Many are large, with bi- or multinucleation and flower-like multilobated nuclei set in abundant basophilic cytoplasm, while others are binucleate or mononuclear with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and small cytoplasmic vacuoles. At lower power the plasma cells are numerous and variable in size among residual hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with pleomorphic (multinucleated/multilobated) plasma cell morphology; clonality should be confirmed by light chain restriction and cytogenetic/FISH risk assessment performed.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, mostly perivascular and polytypic, without giant multinucleated or multilobated forms.
Megakaryocytes have granular pink cytoplasm with a single lobulated nucleus and osteoclasts have many separate uniform nuclei, whereas these cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with hofs.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are immunoblastic with prominent central nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBV+ and extramedullary, rather than mature-appearing pleomorphic plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters (cytokeratin+) and ALCL hallmark cells are CD30+ T cells, while myeloma cells are CD138+ with monotypic cytoplasmic light chain.

captions: Plasma cells with multilobated and eccentric nuclei
Binucleate and cleaved plasma cells with basophilic cytoplasm
Low power: numerous pleomorphic plasma cells

60530.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色（未標示抗體）中，一群散在、強陽性的小至中型淋巴細胞呈膜狀與細胞質棕色染色，形狀不規則；其間大多數細胞核卵圓淡染的細胞為陰性，可見兩個脂肪空泡；陽性細胞只佔一部分，屬於某一 T 細胞亞群的分布型態。
features: IHC with brown DAB chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain; antibody not labeled
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in a subset of scattered small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular shapes
Majority of cells, including larger cells with pale oval nuclei (histiocyte-like), are negative or only weakly blushed
Positive cells distributed evenly without forming sheets
Two round clear fat vacuoles in the field
60530.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining in a subset of scattered, irregularly shaped small-to-medium lymphoid cells, evenly distributed through the infiltrate. The majority of the cells, including larger cells with pale oval nuclei resembling epithelioid histiocytes, are negative, with only faint background blush. The antibody is not labeled, so it cannot be determined from the image which lineage subset is highlighted; a pattern like this would be expected with a T-cell subset marker (such as CD8) or a cytotoxic marker. In the context of the title, this represents part of the immunophenotypic workup of lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphadenitis with mixed T-cell subsets
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes show a normal CD4:CD8 ratio with intact pan-T antigens and polyclonal TCR, unlike an aberrant clonal T-cell population.
Classic Hodgkin lymphoma is identified by CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells rather than by T-cell subset distribution.
AITL neoplastic cells are CD4+ TFH cells (PD1, CXCL13) with expanded follicular dendritic cell networks.

60466.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結結構消失，被大量背靠背、大小相近、邊界模糊的淡染腫瘤性濾泡取代，濾泡間有纖維束穿插，缺乏正常極性與清楚套區，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by numerous closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic follicles
Follicles are enlarged, similar in size and shape, with pale monotonous centers
Attenuated or absent mantle zones; thin dark interfollicular lymphoid rims
Interlacing sclerotic collagen bands between follicles
Cytologic grade (centroblast count) not assessable at this magnification
60466.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows complete effacement of the normal architecture by numerous back-to-back, enlarged, monotonous follicles with attenuated mantle zones and interlacing fibrous bands. The follicles lack the size variation and polarization of reactive germinal centers. Grading requires high-power evaluation of centroblasts and assessment for solid sheets of centroblasts, which cannot be performed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a follicular lymphoma; the grade 3B designation requires high-power confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show polarization with tingible-body macrophages and intact mantles, and are BCL2 negative in germinal centers.
NLPBCL nodules are larger, composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP (popcorn) cells, and lack BCL2-positive germinal center B cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising in follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without follicular dendritic meshworks, which must be excluded in FL grade 3B.
MCL nodules are composed of monotonous small cleaved cells that are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive.

60274.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被成片、單一形態的小至中型淋巴球瀰漫取代，核圓、染色質顆粒狀，部分細胞可見小核仁（前淋巴球），細胞質少，濾泡結構消失；這種單調圓核淋巴球浸潤是 CLL/SLL 的表現，需 CD5/CD23/LEF1 等免疫染色確認。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture by a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate
Small-to-intermediate cells with round, regular nuclei and granular chromatin
Scattered cells with slightly larger nuclei, more open chromatin and small central nucleoli (prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts)
Scant pale cytoplasm; occasional mitotic figures
Thin-walled vessels traversing the infiltrate; no follicles or starry-sky pattern
60274.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of architecture by a monotonous population of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round, regular nuclei, granular chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm. Scattered slightly larger cells with more open chromatin and small central nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts, are interspersed, and occasional mitoses are seen. No residual follicles, starry-sky pattern or necrosis are present in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma/chronic lymphocytic leukemia; immunohistochemistry (CD5, CD23, LEF1, cyclin D1) is recommended, and if the larger cells form confluent sheets, expanded proliferation centers or large-cell transformation should be considered.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have irregular, slightly angulated nuclei without paraimmunoblasts or proliferation centers, often with pink histiocytes and hyalinized vessels, and are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD23-negative.
MZL cells have more abundant pale (monocytoid) cytoplasm, colonize follicles and are CD5- and CD23-negative.
LPL shows plasmacytoid differentiation with Dutcher bodies and clonal plasma cells and lacks CD5/CD23 coexpression.
Richter shows confluent sheets of large cells with nuclei larger than histiocyte nuclei and high Ki-67, rather than scattered paraimmunoblasts in a small-cell background.

60146.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被母細胞佔滿：大型母細胞核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻、核仁可見、細胞質中等偏藍；另有較小、細胞質極少的母細胞混雜，殘存正常造血細胞很少，提示混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Sheets of blasts with markedly reduced residual hematopoiesis
Intermediate-to-large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm, deeper blue at the periphery in some cells
Admixed smaller blasts with scant cytoplasm and less conspicuous nucleoli
Occasional residual segmented neutrophil, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors; no Auer rods seen
60146.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and composed predominantly of blasts. Most are intermediate to large, with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, while a subset of smaller blasts has scant cytoplasm and indistinct nucleoli. Residual maturing hematopoietic elements are sparse, and Auer rods are not identified. The findings indicate acute leukemia; with flow cytometry demonstrating more than one lineage, they are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML lacks lineage-defining lymphoid antigens (cytoplasmic CD3 or strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10) on flow cytometry.
ALL is MPO negative without monocytic markers, and flow is required because morphology alone cannot assign lineage.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and express CD41/CD61, which would be evident on flow or IHC.

60082.recognize_zh: 切片中巨核細胞明顯增多，多為體積大、細胞質豐富、核深度分葉的成熟型，多數散在分布、偶呈鬆散小群，核染色質不呈濃密雲團狀；這種大型成熟巨核細胞增生符合本態性血小板增多症（ET）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly increased megakaryocytes
Large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Deeply lobulated, hyperlobated nuclei with mature (not hyperchromatic, not bulbous) chromatin
Megakaryocytes mostly dispersed or in small loose groups, without dense tight clusters
Intervening erythroid and granulocytic precursors with preserved maturation; bony trabeculae at edges
60082.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a marked increase in megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are predominantly large to giant with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, hyperlobated nuclei with mature chromatin; they are distributed singly or in small loose groups without dense clustering or bizarre hyperchromatic forms. Background erythroid and granulocytic elements show orderly maturation, and there is no evident increase in blasts. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia, with reticulin staining and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation testing recommended to exclude prefibrotic primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes form dense clusters and show atypia with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei and aberrant N:C ratio, often with granulocytic predominance.
Displays panmyelosis with erythroid hyperplasia and megakaryocytes of widely variable size rather than uniformly large mature forms.
Megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated in a granulocyte-rich marrow; BCR::ABL1 must be excluded in every suspected ET.
Megakaryocytes lack the prominent giant hyperlobated morphology and no MPN driver mutation is present.

60018.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全由單一型態的母細胞取代：中到大型、核質比高、染色質細緻、核形略不規則，細胞質淡藍且完全無顆粒或 Auer 小體；型態上看不出分化方向，須靠 MPO/NSE 陰性及流式缺乏系別標記才能歸為未分化型。
features: Sheet of monotonous intermediate to large blasts replacing normal elements
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to angulated, slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
No Auer rods, granules, or vacuoles
Rare residual granulocyte at top; smudged cells and platelets in background
60018.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of intermediate to large blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contours, and scant to moderate agranular pale-blue cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent, and residual maturing hematopoietic elements are rare. The morphology does not indicate lineage. With negative myeloperoxidase and nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and absence of lineage-specific markers by flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are MPO negative by cytochemistry but express at least two myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33, or CD117, unlike AUL.
Megakaryoblasts may show cytoplasmic blebs and express CD41/CD61, which should be tested before diagnosing AUL.
Lymphoblasts are also MPO/NSE negative but express B (CD19, cCD79a, CD10) or T (cCD3) lineage markers.
BPDCN expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4 and often presents with skin lesions.

24178.recognize_zh: 這是 FISH 與染色體圖而非形態：間期細胞核內出現大量散布或成團的 MYC 訊號（像煙火一樣），分裂中期也見到許多散在的訊號、倒相 DAPI 核型可見大量雙微體（double minutes），代表 MYC 基因擴增，常見於骨髓發育不良相關 AML。
features: Interphase FISH: many nuclei with numerous amplified probe signals, clustered or scattered throughout the nucleus ('fireworks')
Some nuclei show only a few normal signals (non-amplified cells)
Metaphase FISH: many small signals scattered around and between chromosomes, consistent with extrachromosomal amplification
Inverted DAPI/G-banded metaphase shows numerous tiny paired chromatin bodies (double minutes)
24178.describe_en: Interphase FISH with a MYC probe shows a large proportion of nuclei with innumerable amplified signals, either clustered or dispersed, alongside occasional nuclei with a normal signal pattern. Metaphase FISH demonstrates numerous small signals scattered among the chromosomes rather than confined to a single chromosomal locus, and the corresponding banded metaphase shows multiple double minute chromosomes. Findings indicate high-level MYC amplification in the form of double minutes, a rare adverse-risk finding typically seen in AML with myelodysplasia-related changes and complex karyotype.

ddx.dx: MYC amplification as homogeneously staining region (hsr)
ddx.vs: In an hsr the amplified signals are clustered on one marker chromosome at metaphase rather than scattered as double minutes.
A break-apart pattern shows split red and green signals without increased copy number, unlike the many signals seen here.
Trisomy 8 yields three discrete MYC signals per nucleus, not dozens.

17970.recognize_zh: 視野中大多數紅血球呈橢圓形至長桿狀（elliptocytes），部分仍保有中央淡染區，缺乏破碎紅血球、球形紅血球或明顯大小不均，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症（hereditary elliptocytosis）。
features: Majority of RBCs are oval to elongated elliptocytes, some rod/cigar-shaped
Many elliptocytes retain central pallor, indicating normochromic cells
Relatively uniform cell size without marked anisocytosis
No significant schistocytes, spherocytes, target cells or teardrop cells
Scattered platelets; no nucleated RBCs or inclusions seen
17970.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking predominance of elliptical and elongated rod-shaped erythrocytes, accounting for the majority of red cells in the field. The elliptocytes are relatively uniform in size and many retain central pallor. Schistocytes, spherocytes, teardrop cells and red cell inclusions are not evident, and platelets appear present. In an asymptomatic young adult, findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytic cells with anisocytosis and only occasional pencil cells, not a uniform population of normochromic elliptocytes.
SAO shows stomatocytic macro-ovalocytes with one or two transverse bars or slits, rather than slender elliptocytes with preserved central pallor.
HPP shows marked microspherocytes, fragments and bizarre poikilocytes with very low MCV in addition to elliptocytes.
Acquired conditions show mixed poikilocytes such as dacrocytes, leukoerythroblastosis or dysplastic granulocytes rather than a pure elliptocyte population.

15794.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中滿是異常前骨髓細胞，細胞核深度凹折或呈雙葉「蝴蝶狀」（bilobed/butterfly），細胞質顆粒極少或只見細小粉塵樣顆粒，這是微顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL M3v）的特徵。
features: Sheet of medium-to-large abnormal cells in the blood smear with high to moderate N:C ratio
Nuclei deeply folded, reniform or bilobed with a characteristic butterfly/dumbbell configuration
Fine, delicate chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant to moderate cytoplasm that appears nearly agranular or with fine dust-like granules; no obvious Auer rods in this field
Numerous abnormal cells with markedly increased white count (typical of hyperleukocytosis in M3v)
15794.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-to-large abnormal promyelocytes arranged in a dense band. The cells have deeply folded, reniform to bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and scant to moderate cytoplasm that appears largely agranular or contains only fine, dust-like granules. Coarse granules and Auer rod bundles are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; strong MPO positivity, CD34/HLA-DR negativity and PML::RARA confirmation are needed, and treatment should not be delayed given the coagulopathy risk.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles and fine folded nuclei but are nonspecific esterase positive, MPO weak and usually HLA-DR positive, unlike the strongly MPO-positive HLA-DR-negative M3v cells.
Classic APL shows coarse, nucleus-obscuring azurophilic granules and faggot cells with multiple Auer rods, whereas M3v appears agranular on light microscopy.
Sézary cells have dense convoluted cerebriform chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm and are CD3+/CD4+ and MPO negative.
NPM1-mutated AML may show cup-like nuclear invaginations and HLA-DR/CD34 negativity, requiring PML::RARA testing to exclude APL.

13042.recognize_zh: 左側骨髓抹片可見成群的紅血球前驅細胞，其中有雙核、呈苜蓿葉狀的正染性紅母細胞（binucleated erythroblast）；右側臨床照片見手指痛風石變形與腳趾潰瘍。遺傳性貧血加上雙核紅母細胞，符合先天性造血不良性貧血第二型（CDA II），高紅血球更新率則導致續發性痛風。
features: Erythroid precursors at intermediate to late stages with round nuclei and polychromatophilic to orthochromatic cytoplasm
Binucleated erythroblast with two equal-sized round nuclei (lower right) and a small cluster of erythroid precursors (upper left)
Condensed, dark nuclear chromatin in the late erythroblasts; no megaloblastic open chromatin
Background red cells with marked anisopoikilocytosis, including ovalocytes, teardrop-like and fragmented forms
Composite clinical photographs: nodular tophaceous deformity of the fingers and an ulcerated, necrotic great toe
13042.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained marrow smear (left panel) shows erythroid precursors, including a binucleated late erythroblast with two equal round nuclei and a small cluster of maturing erythroblasts, set against red cells with marked anisopoikilocytosis. Nuclear chromatin is condensed without megaloblastic features, and no ringed sideroblast assessment is possible on this stain. The accompanying clinical photographs show tophaceous deformity of the fingers and an ulcerated toe. In a young transfused patient with consanguinity and normal hemoglobin electrophoresis, the findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II complicated by secondary tophaceous gout; confirmation requires SEC23B sequencing or SDS-PAGE band 3 analysis.

ddx.vs: CDA I shows internuclear chromatin bridges and spongy 'Swiss cheese' heterochromatin on electron microscopy rather than predominance of binucleated late erythroblasts.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts have open, finely stippled chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and are accompanied by giant metamyelocytes, which are absent here.
Thalassemia shows microcytic target cells and abnormal hemoglobin studies (raised HbA2/HbF), whereas this patient has normal electrophoresis and binucleated erythroblasts.
MDS occurs in older adults with multilineage dysplasia and clonal cytogenetic or molecular lesions, not a lifelong familial anemia.

12530.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中箭頭指出的紅血球邊緣有半月形缺口，像被咬掉一口的咬痕細胞（bite cell），配合服用 dapsone 的病史，提示氧化性溶血。
features: Scattered bite cells (degmacytes) with smooth semicircular peripheral defects, marked by arrows
Background red cells largely normocytic with preserved central pallor; mild anisocytosis
Occasional red cells with eccentric hemoglobin (blister-like) appearance
No spherocyte predominance, schistocytes or agglutination
Neutrophil, lymphocyte and adequate platelets present
12530.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mostly normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered bite cells showing smooth, semicircular membrane defects (arrows). Spherocytes, schistocytes and red cell agglutination are not prominent. White cells and platelets appear unremarkable. In the setting of dapsone exposure with a negative direct antiglobulin test, findings are consistent with drug-induced oxidative hemolysis; G6PD assay (after recovery) and methemoglobin level are recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical (bite and blister cells, Heinz bodies), so a quantitative G6PD assay performed after reticulocytosis subsides is needed to separate intrinsic deficiency from dose-related dapsone toxicity.
MAHA shows fragmented schistocytes with sharp angular edges and thrombocytopenia rather than smooth rounded bite defects with normal platelets.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and a positive DAT, whereas this smear shows bite cells with a negative DAT.
Unstable hemoglobins also produce bite cells and Heinz bodies but are congenital with lifelong hemolysis and detectable by isopropanol stability testing or Hb analysis.

3314.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁有大片黏著樣排列的大型異型細胞，細胞質豐富嗜酸至雙染性、核呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，部分核呈腎形或馬蹄形，並可見多個核分裂，符合 ALCL 侵犯骨髓。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm, mimicking a cohesive carcinoma
Vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli; some kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei suggestive of hallmark cells
Frequent mitotic figures scattered through the infiltrate
Interspersed eosinophils and residual small hematopoietic cells
Bony trabecula at lower left with diffuse replacement of the adjacent marrow space
3314.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular space adjacent to a bony trabecula that is extensively replaced by sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells have vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli, some with reniform or horseshoe shapes, and mitotic figures are frequent; scattered eosinophils and residual hematopoietic cells are intermixed. The cohesive sheet-like growth can mimic metastatic carcinoma. Findings are consistent with involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by strong uniform CD30 and ALK immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is keratin positive and melanoma S100/SOX10 positive, whereas ALCL is CD30 and ALK (or EMA) positive and keratin negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45- and ALK-, rather than forming sheets.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: It expresses B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5, CD79a) and is ALK negative.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows variable, heterogeneous CD30 and lacks the uniform strong CD30 with hallmark cells and ALK rearrangement.

3378.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中淋巴球數量明顯增多，箭頭標示的是略大、核深染且輪廓不規則的異型淋巴球（Sézary 細胞）；此倍率看不清腦迴狀核溝，需高倍確認。
features: Increased numbers of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with dense, hyperchromatic nuclei (lymphocytosis)
Arrowed cells slightly larger with irregular nuclear outlines and scant cytoplasm, suggestive of Sézary cells
Cerebriform nuclear folding not resolvable at this low magnification
Scattered mature segmented neutrophils and numerous platelets
Red cells with some target cells and minor shape variation
3378.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small to intermediate lymphoid cells with dense, hyperchromatic nuclei among scattered neutrophils and numerous platelets. The arrowed cells are slightly larger with irregular nuclear contours and scant cytoplasm, suggestive of Sézary cells, although the characteristic cerebriform nuclear grooves cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating Sézary cells; high-power review and flow cytometry (CD4+ T cells with loss of CD7 and/or CD26) are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like clumped chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells rather than CD4+ T cells.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with more abundant cytoplasm and lack clonal T-cell phenotype or TCR rearrangement.
ATLL cells show flower-like polylobated nuclei on high power, CD25 expression and HTLV-1 serology.

3186.recognize_zh: 周邊血中單一顆比小淋巴球大的異型淋巴樣細胞，圓核染色質粗而成塊、細胞質為一圈淡藍色；圖中顆粒不易辨識，單看形態不具專一性，需結合 CD56+ 流式與臨床才能歸為侵襲性 NK 細胞白血病。
features: Single atypical lymphoid cell larger than a small lymphocyte
Round nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleolus not evident
Thin to moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm; fine azurophilic granules not clearly resolved in this image
Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes/teardrop-like forms
Scattered small dark particles likely representing platelets or stain precipitate
3186.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large atypical lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, coarse clumped chromatin, no conspicuous nucleolus and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm; cytoplasmic granules are subtle and not clearly resolved at this resolution. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. A single cell of this type is not diagnostic by morphology. In the setting of flow cytometry showing surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive NK cells, EBV positivity and a fulminant clinical course, the findings are consistent with circulating cells of aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with distinct azurophilic granules and a heterogeneous, non-clonal phenotype.
T-LGL cells are small to intermediate mature granular lymphocytes that are surface CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ with an indolent course.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cell (e.g. DLBCL or mantle cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: B-cell lymphoma cells express CD19/CD20 and lack NK markers.
Reactive lymphocytes show a spectrum of forms with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, and resolve with infection.

1202.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，一群核大、核仁明顯的大型細胞呈細胞膜與高基氏區點狀陽性，其餘小淋巴球陰性；配合原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）臨床背景，屬於大細胞的部分表現型佐證，但單張無法確立診斷。
features: Mixed population of large atypical cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei and occasional distinct nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes
Brown membranous and paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) staining in a subset of the large cells
Small mature lymphocytes and background cells are negative
Marker not labeled; the membrane/Golgi pattern resembles CD30 or CD138 staining
1202.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not specified) performed on a cell block/tissue preparation shows a mixed population of large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and small lymphocytes. A subset of the large cells shows membranous and paranuclear dot-like positivity, while small lymphocytes are negative. The staining pattern is compatible with an activation or plasmacytic marker such as CD30 or CD138, but the specific antibody cannot be determined from the image. In the appropriate clinical context, findings support involvement by primary effusion lymphoma; confirmation requires HHV8 (LANA) positivity.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 with T-cell or ALK expression and is HHV8-negative, whereas PEL is HHV8 LANA-positive with a null/plasmablastic phenotype.
Plasmablastic lymphoma usually forms a solid mass, is EBV-positive and HHV8-negative, unlike PEL.
Mesothelial cells are cytokeratin, calretinin and WT1 positive and lack CD45, CD138 or HHV8 expression.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin/epithelial marker positive and lacks lymphoid and HHV8 markers.

1778.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中病人雙腿（大腿與小腿）有多處大片、邊界銳利的地圖狀深褐色壞死結痂，表面網格狀剝落並有出血，病灶之間皮膚正常；水痘後出現這種肢體大範圍出血性皮膚壞死，符合後天性 protein S 缺乏所致暴發性紫斑。
features: Multiple large, sharply demarcated, geographic necrotic plaques on the thigh and lower leg
Dark brown to black eschar with reticulated, peeling surface
Hemorrhagic red foci along lesion margins
Lesions involve the lower extremities with intervening normal-appearing skin
No visible vesicular varicella lesions in this photograph
1778.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows the lower extremities with several large, sharply marginated, geographic plaques of dark necrotic eschar on the thigh and lower leg, with reticulated desquamation and hemorrhagic margins, separated by normal skin. The lesions represent established full-thickness hemorrhagic skin necrosis. In a child recovering from varicella, the distribution and appearance are consistent with post-infectious purpura fulminans due to acquired anti-protein S antibodies, which requires urgent anticoagulation and factor replacement and carries risk of large-vessel thrombosis and limb loss.

ddx.vs: Occurs during septic shock with DIC rather than as a delayed post-varicella complication with isolated protein S deficiency.

ddx.dx: Homozygous protein C or S deficiency
ddx.vs: Presents in the neonatal period with purpura fulminans and undetectable protein C or S activity.
Temporally linked to initiation of warfarin, typically in fatty areas.
Accompanied by severe pain, crepitus, systemic toxicity and positive tissue cultures rather than a coagulation defect.

1330.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭所指為核偏心、染色質塊狀、細胞質灰藍並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，數量散在增加，中央是一顆大型巨核細胞作為對照；在類澱粉沉積症中這些漿細胞代表潛在的克隆性漿細胞群，但抹片本身看不到類澱粉或凝血因子 X 缺乏。
features: Scattered plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and grey-blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof
Plasma cells are mature-appearing without prominent nucleoli or multinucleation
Large megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm in the center
Background of trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
No amorphous extracellular amyloid material evident on this smear
1330.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with a centrally placed megakaryocyte and scattered mature-appearing plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, and perinuclear hofs. The plasma cells lack prominent nucleoli or atypical forms, and a precise percentage cannot be estimated from a single field. No extracellular amyloid is evident on the smear. In a patient with amyloidosis, these findings support an underlying plasma cell dyscrasia; clonality should be established by kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry or flow cytometry, and acquired factor X deficiency is a laboratory finding that cannot be assessed morphologically.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells look identical, so light chain restriction by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry is required to distinguish them.
Myeloma usually shows at least 10% clonal plasma cells, often sheets, immature or binucleate forms, and end-organ damage, which cannot be confirmed from this field.
Osteoblasts are larger with a hof separated from the nucleus and occur in clusters, whereas these cells are smaller with a juxtanuclear hof.

2930.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中，許多血小板像花圈一樣黏附在嗜中性球周圍，形成血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），其他區域游離血小板相對稀少，這是EDTA引起的假性血小板減少。
features: Numerous platelets adherent in a rosette around a band/segmented neutrophil in the center
A second neutrophil immediately adjacent is also partly rimmed by platelets
Platelets themselves are normal in size and granularity
Relatively few free platelets elsewhere in the field
Incidental small lymphocyte and a neutrophil with vacuolated cytoplasm at lower left
2930.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with a relative paucity of free platelets. Centrally, numerous normal-appearing platelets are adherent to and encircle a neutrophil, with platelets also clustering against an adjacent neutrophil, forming the characteristic rosette of platelet satellitism. A small lymphocyte and a neutrophil with mildly vacuolated cytoplasm are also present. No schistocytes are seen. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, a cause of spurious thrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrate or heparin anticoagulant is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows a genuine scarcity of platelets without platelets adhering to leukocytes or forming clumps.
Platelet clumping shows free-floating platelet aggregates not attached to leukocytes, often at the feathered edge, although both may coexist.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm rather than being rimmed around the outer membrane.

2610.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個大型紅血球前驅細胞，細胞核內有淡染、玻璃樣的病毒包涵體，染色質被推擠到核膜邊緣形成一圈深色環（lantern cell），是微小病毒 B19 感染的特徵。
features: Scattered giant pronormoblasts with large round nuclei
Glassy, pale eosinophilic to clear intranuclear inclusions
Chromatin marginated against the nuclear membrane, forming a dark rim
Adjacent clusters of immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei and open chromatin
Background of maturing granulocytes, eosinophils and fat spaces in a cellular marrow
2610.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows cellular marrow with a mixed population of myeloid and erythroid elements. Scattered large erythroid precursors contain glassy, pale intranuclear inclusions that push the chromatin to the periphery of the nucleus, producing a dark rim around a cleared center. Clusters of early erythroid precursors are present, while late normoblasts are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection of erythroid progenitors; confirmation by B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: CMV inclusions are large, dark owl-eye intranuclear inclusions with a halo, often with granular cytoplasmic inclusions, and involve endothelial or stromal cells rather than being confined to erythroid precursors.

Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of monotonous proerythroblasts without viral inclusions and with an erythroid predominance, whereas here the precursors are scattered with glassy inclusions and marginated chromatin.
Megaloblastic precursors show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all maturation stages and giant metamyelocytes, not glassy intranuclear inclusions.
HSV/VZV cause multinucleation with nuclear molding and ground-glass chromatin, usually with necrosis, rather than isolated giant erythroid precursors.

1074.recognize_zh: 多顆漿細胞核偏位、細胞質藍色，核上布滿數顆大小不一、淡藍色的圓形小體（Dutcher bodies），中央兩顆漿細胞尤其明顯。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderately abundant blue cytoplasm
Multiple pale blue, round, well-demarcated inclusions over the nuclei (Dutcher bodies) in many cells
Two central plasma cells with numerous small nuclear inclusions of varying size
Some plasma cells with single larger inclusions
Background of maturing neutrophils, bands, and an eosinophil
1074.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and blue cytoplasm. Many plasma cells contain one to multiple pale blue, round, sharply outlined nuclear inclusions consistent with Dutcher bodies, particularly prominent in two central cells. The background contains maturing granulocytes and an eosinophil. The frequency of Dutcher bodies favors a clonal plasmacytic process such as a plasma cell neoplasm or a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Russell bodies are cytoplasmic and distend the cytoplasm, not overlying the nucleus.
Nucleoli are purple, not pale blue, and are embedded in dispersed chromatin rather than appearing as glassy round globules.
Reactive plasma cells rarely show Dutcher bodies and are polytypic on kappa/lambda studies.

4146.recognize_zh: 中央單一淋巴球，細胞比小淋巴球大、細胞質豐富淡藍色，內含散在的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核圓略偏心、染色質凝集，即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Medium-to-large lymphocyte with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered fine-to-coarse azurophilic granules
Round to slightly oval, eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Background normocytic normochromic RBCs and normal platelets
4146.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin, no visible nucleolus, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered azurophilic granules. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets appear normal. The cell is a morphologically typical large granular lymphocyte; a sustained LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement and STAT3 mutation would support T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive (Downey) lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around RBCs with peripheral basophilia and typically lack prominent azurophilic granules.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells are larger and more atypical with open chromatin and nucleoli, and are EBV-positive.
Myeloid precursors have more numerous, dense granules and a larger nucleus with finer chromatin or a Golgi hof.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like projections and lack azurophilic granules.

4018.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片右側被成片、核卵圓擁擠、染色質細緻、細胞質少的腫瘤細胞取代，細胞間可見核擠壓與核分裂，左側殘存正常造血與巨核細胞；這種與周邊造血組織分界的成片小至中型細胞浸潤，符合小細胞神經內分泌癌骨髓轉移。
features: Sheets and nests of crowded tumor cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Nuclear molding and occasional mitotic and apoptotic figures
Pink amorphous stromal/fibrinous material between tumor nests
Residual normal hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and erythroid precursors on the left
Sharp interface between tumor infiltrate and residual marrow
4018.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows extensive replacement of the marrow by sheets and nests of tumor cells with crowded oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, with nuclear molding and scattered mitoses. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is present on one side of the field and is sharply demarcated from the infiltrate. Findings are consistent with metastatic small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma; immunohistochemistry for keratin and neuroendocrine markers with negative CD45 should confirm non-hematopoietic origin.

ddx.vs: Lymphoma infiltrates are discohesive with more vesicular nuclei and nucleoli, and are CD45 and CD20 positive but keratin negative.
Leukemia diffusely replaces marrow without a nested cohesive pattern or nuclear molding, and blasts express CD34, TdT or myeloid markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic poorly differentiated non-small cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Non-small cell carcinoma shows larger cells with more cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, whereas small-cell carcinoma has fine chromatin and molding.

3890.recognize_zh: 高倍下骨髓中一片由單調的小型圓形淋巴球組成的緻密結節，細胞核圓、染色質致密、細胞質極少，周邊仍有造血細胞與脂肪，是 CLL 結節型浸潤的細胞組成。
features: Dense nodular aggregate of monotonous small lymphocytes
Round nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Occasional slightly larger cells with paler nuclei (possible prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts)
Aggregate molds around adipocytes without destructive growth
Residual hematopoietic cells, including a megakaryocyte, at the periphery
3890.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a dense nodular aggregate composed of monotonous small lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, with occasional slightly larger cells with paler nuclei. The aggregate molds around adipocytes and is bordered by residual hematopoietic elements, including a megakaryocyte. Germinal centers are not seen. Findings are consistent with nodular involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; immunohistochemistry for CD20, CD5, CD23 and LEF1 is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are smaller, contain mixed T and B cells with histiocytes and small vessels, and lack the CD5/CD23 co-expressing B-cell phenotype.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells have slightly irregular nuclei without proliferation centers and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
LPL shows admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes, plasma cells and mast cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure small lymphocyte population.

3954.recognize_zh: 血片呈明顯大小不一與異形紅血球：大量低色素小球性細胞、標靶細胞、碎片與淚滴狀細胞，同時混有飽滿的正常色素細胞（箭頭處為小而緻密的球形細胞），符合嚴重地中海型貧血。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with many hypochromic microcytes
Target cells, teardrop cells, and irregular red cell fragments
Dimorphic picture with a subpopulation of well-hemoglobinized normocytes
Small dense round red cell (arrow), microspherocyte-like
Few platelets; no nucleated red cells in this field
3954.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous hypochromic microcytes, target cells, teardrop cells, and irregular red cell fragments. A second population of well-hemoglobinized normocytic cells is present, producing a dimorphic picture, and small dense microspherocyte-like cells are seen (arrow). Nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a severe thalassemia syndrome (e.g., beta-thalassemia major/intermedia or HbH disease), with the dimorphic population possibly reflecting transfusion.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency rarely produces this degree of poikilocytosis, fragments, and target cells, and has low ferritin rather than normal/increased iron stores.
MAHA shows helmet cells and schistocytes in a normochromic background with thrombocytopenia, not diffuse hypochromic microcytosis with target cells.
HPP shows striking microspherocytes and budding fragments with very low MCV but lacks hypochromia and target cells, and has spectrin defects.
Sideroblastic anemia gives a dimorphic hypochromic population but with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts, and normal globin chain studies.

3826.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質淡染、充滿大小一致的細小空泡（泡沫狀，foamy），核小而偏位，周圍是正常造血細胞，符合 Niemann-Pick 細胞。
features: Single large histiocyte, several times the diameter of adjacent myeloid cells
Abundant pale cytoplasm packed with uniform small clear vacuoles (foamy / soap-bubble appearance)
Small, eccentric, irregular nucleus with low N:C ratio
No striated or crinkled-paper cytoplasm and no sea-blue coloration
Background of maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes and normocytic red cells
3826.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoietic elements with a conspicuous large histiocyte in the center of the field. The histiocyte has abundant pale cytoplasm filled with numerous uniform small lipid vacuoles and a small eccentric nucleus. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture of Gaucher cells. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of Niemann-Pick disease in the appropriate clinical and enzymatic/genetic context.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete uniform vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules on Romanowsky stain, whereas this cell is pale and uniformly vacuolated.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher / foamy macrophages in high cell turnover or hyperlipidemia
ddx.vs: Secondary foamy macrophages are morphologically similar, so enzyme assay (acid sphingomyelinase) or NPC1/NPC2 testing and clinical context are needed.

3570.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆特別大的顆粒球，核分成七八個小葉（過度分葉、巨大化），右側有雙核的顆粒球系前驅細胞，下方還有一團重疊的未成熟細胞；異常分葉與雙核化是顆粒球系發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）的表現。
features: Giant granulocyte with a hypersegmented nucleus of about 7-8 lobes and coarse chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Binucleate granulocytic precursor at right with two separate nuclei in pale cytoplasm
Cluster of overlapping, hyperchromatic immature cells at lower center, partly crushed
Band/metamyelocyte at lower left; granular background with platelets
3570.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged granulocyte with a hypersegmented nucleus of 7-8 lobes and finely granular cytoplasm. An adjacent granulocytic precursor is binucleate, and a cluster of overlapping, partly crushed immature cells is present below. These nuclear abnormalities represent dysgranulopoiesis. The differential includes myelodysplastic neoplasm and non-clonal causes such as megaloblastic anemia or drug effect, so correlation with B12/folate levels, blast count, and cytogenetics is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows giant metamyelocytes and bands plus nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in erythroid precursors, and it resolves with vitamin replacement.
Medication history is required, since drug-induced dysplasia lacks clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
The hereditary form is a benign isolated finding in mature neutrophils without giant cells, binucleation, or cytopenias.
It shows similar multilineage dysplasia, but the diagnosis relies on prior cytotoxic therapy and often complex or TP53-mutated karyotype.

3698.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 切片中為混合性浸潤：大量小淋巴球與淡染、核呈腎形或新月形的組織球，夾雜免疫母細胞與散在的核碎裂碎屑，且幾乎沒有嗜中性球或嗜酸性球，符合菊池病（Kikuchi lymphadenitis）增生期。
features: Paracortical-type mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, and immunoblasts
Histiocytes with pale cytoplasm and indented, crescentic, or twisted nuclei
Scattered apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris without confluent necrosis
Absence of neutrophils, eosinophils, and granulomas
Scattered plasmacytoid-appearing cells and small vessels in the background
3698.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a paracortical mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, immunoblasts, and numerous histiocytes with pale cytoplasm and crescentic or indented nuclei. Scattered apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris are present without confluent necrosis at this field, and neutrophils and eosinophils are notably absent. No granulomas or sheets of atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease), proliferative phase; immunostains (CD68/MPO-positive histiocytes, CD8-predominant T cells) and lupus serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows cytologically atypical medium to large T cells with loss of pan-T antigens and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than a mixed histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
Similar pattern but with hematoxylin bodies, more plasma cells, and positive ANA/anti-dsDNA serology.
Immunoblast-like cells form sheets of CD20-positive large B cells, unlike the scattered immunoblasts here.
Shows stellate necrotizing granulomas with central neutrophils (microabscesses) and Bartonella on Warthin-Starry stain or PCR.

3506.recognize_zh: 紅血球堆成不規則、立體的葡萄串狀大團塊，並非直線錢串狀排列，旁邊還有散在的鋸齒狀紅血球（echinocytes）與一個分葉核嗜中性球，典型的紅血球凝集表現。
features: Large irregular three-dimensional clusters of overlapping red cells in a grape-like pattern
Aggregates are non-linear, distinguishing agglutination from rouleaux
Scattered crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely artifactual
Single segmented neutrophil and a few platelets
Individual red cells between clumps are largely normocytic
3506.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent red cell agglutination, with large irregular, three-dimensional clusters of erythrocytes rather than linear rouleaux. Scattered crenated red cells are present, likely a drying artifact. A segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination, as seen in cold agglutinin-mediated autoimmune hemolytic anemia; correlation with a warmed specimen, DAT (C3d), and cold agglutinin titer is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear coin-stack arrays and disperse with saline replacement, whereas agglutinates are irregular clumps.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and does not typically form large agglutinates.
Artifactual clumping is limited to thick areas and lacks the persistent grape-like aggregates at the thin edge.

3250.recognize_zh: 一群細胞質帶空泡的巨噬細胞與單核細胞聚在一起，左上那顆的細胞質內只有一個具透亮暈圈與新月形染色質的小酵母菌；菌量很少，需仔細搜尋其他巨噬細胞才能確認組織漿菌病。
features: Cluster of macrophages/monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm
Single small oval intracellular yeast with clear halo and eccentric chromatin near a nucleus (upper left)
Fine reticular pale blue cytoplasm with vesicles
Adjacent small lymphocyte with dense chromatin
Organism burden in this field is very low
3250.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a cluster of macrophages and monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and vacuolated, finely reticular cytoplasm, together with a small lymphocyte. One macrophage contains a single small oval intracellular yeast form with a clear halo and eccentric crescentic chromatin. The organism burden is very low in this field. The findings support Histoplasma capsulatum infection in context, but with only a single organism, confirmation by additional fields, GMS stain, antigen testing or culture is required.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a kinetoplast in addition to the nucleus and lack a halo.
Reactive macrophages contain only clear vacuoles and debris without a walled organism bearing a halo and nuclear dot.
HLH macrophages contain engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells rather than yeasts, though histoplasmosis can trigger HLH.

3122.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆紅血球母細胞的胞質（及其上方）布滿粗大深藍色點狀顆粒，中央一顆細胞淡染胞質內有散在粗顆粒，呈現粗大嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling）。
features: Increased erythroid precursors at various stages
Coarse dark blue punctate stippling in the cytoplasm of many erythroblasts
Central cell with dense dark nucleus and pale cytoplasm containing discrete coarse dark granules
Some red cells and a nucleated red cell with small inclusions
Occasional granulocytes and a band neutrophil at left
3122.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous erythroid precursors, many of which contain coarse, dark blue punctate cytoplasmic stippling. A central cell with a dense nucleus shows discrete coarse dark granules scattered in pale cytoplasm; a basophil is a morphologic consideration for that cell, although the pattern matches the adjacent stippled erythroblasts. A few mature red cells contain small inclusions. Findings are suggestive of coarse basophilic stippling of erythroid precursors, as seen in pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency, lead poisoning, or dyserythropoiesis; an iron stain is recommended to exclude siderotic granules.

ddx.vs: Siderotic granules are fewer, clustered at one pole, and stain positively with Prussian blue, whereas basophilic stippling is diffuse and iron-negative.
Basophil granules are larger, purple-black, water-soluble, and overlie a lobulated nucleus in a mature granulocyte rather than an erythroblast.
Precipitate is present over the background and in varying focal planes, not confined to cytoplasm.

3058.recognize_zh: 酸洗脫（Kleihauer-Betke）染色的高倍視野，一些深粉紅、邊緣稍不規則的紅血球夾雜在密集的淡色細胞輪廓網之間；影像失焦且區域太厚，難以判斷 HbF 分布，只能作為 HbS/HPFH 系列圖的輔助。
features: Acid-elution stained film viewed at higher magnification in a thick area
Scattered deeply eosinophilic red cells with slightly crenated, irregular outlines
Background meshwork of pale, closely packed red cell outlines retaining faint pink stain
Focus and thickness limit assessment of the proportion and uniformity of HbF-containing cells
3058.describe_en: High-power view of an acid-elution (Kleihauer-Betke) stained blood film taken from a thick area of the smear. Scattered red cells are intensely eosinophilic with slightly irregular outlines, set among a closely packed network of paler cell outlines that retain faint staining. The thickness of the field and the soft focus prevent reliable judgement of whether HbF is pancellular or heterocellular. In the context of the series, the image is presented as part of the HbS/HPFH evaluation, but interpretation should be based on a thin, well-spread area of the slide.

ddx.dx: Heterocellular HbF (sickle cell disease on hydroxyurea, HbS-beta thalassemia)
ddx.vs: A true heterocellular pattern shows well-separated dark F-cells against empty ghost cells in a thin area, which cannot be confirmed in this thick field.
Fetal red cells in maternal blood are a small minority of uniformly dark cells among clear ghosts, assessed on a monolayer.
Overlapping cells in thick areas retain eosin nonspecifically, mimicking partial staining; counting should be done where cells do not touch.

2994.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）配紅色核複染下，數顆紅血球母細胞的核周圍出現藍綠色鐵顆粒，部分沿核周排列成環狀或半環狀，符合環狀鐵粒母細胞（ringed sideroblasts）。
features: Erythroid precursors with blue-green siderotic granules arranged around the nucleus
Several granules encircle a substantial portion of the nuclear circumference (ring or partial ring)
Other erythroblasts contain only a few scattered granules
Nuclei stained red (nuclear fast red/safranin counterstain); cellular marrow with mixed precursors
No large iron aggregates in this field to assess storage iron
2994.describe_en: Iron-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field of mixed precursors. Several erythroblasts contain coarse blue siderotic granules distributed perinuclearly, some forming rings or partial rings around the nucleus, while others show only scattered granules. A formal count of ringed sideroblasts (at least 5 granules covering at least one third of the nuclear circumference) as a percentage of erythroblasts is required. Findings are consistent with ringed sideroblasts; in a reactive setting, consider alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity or drugs such as isoniazid before a clonal sideroblastic process.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have one to a few small granules randomly scattered in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Morphology alone cannot separate clonal from reactive causes; dysplasia, cytogenetics and SF3B1 mutation testing are needed.
Congenital forms present in young patients with microcytosis and family history, whereas acquired forms are often normo/macrocytic; genetic testing confirms.

2866.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆小至中型淋巴球，核有一道深刻的溝紋與摺疊、染色質緻密，細胞質極少呈淡藍色，即 Sézary 細胞的腦迴狀（cerebriform）核。
features: Small to intermediate lymphocyte, slightly larger than a red cell
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Nucleus with a deep linear groove/fold imparting a cerebriform (coffee-bean) contour
Condensed, hyperchromatic chromatin without visible nucleoli
Background red cells unremarkable
2866.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small to intermediate lymphoid cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and a scant rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. The nucleus is hyperchromatic with a deep groove and folding that produces a cerebriform contour; nucleoli are not seen. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is consistent with a Sézary cell; correlation with flow cytometry and clinical erythroderma is required for the diagnosis of Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells are more polylobated with flower-like nuclei and are associated with HTLV-1 serology and hypercalcemia.
T-PLL cells have a visible central nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with TCL1A overexpression.
Occasional reactive cleaved lymphocytes occur in small numbers and lack a clonal CD4+ CD7−/CD26− population on flow cytometry.

2802.recognize_zh: 數顆大型單核球系細胞，核圓或腎形、染色質細緻，灰藍色細胞質豐富且含細小顆粒，部分有小空泡，形態接近前單核球（promonocyte），左下另有一顆分葉核中性球作對照。
features: Large monocytic cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Oval to reniform or indented nuclei with fine, delicate chromatin; small nucleoli in some
Fine azurophilic granules and scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Cells with immature features resembling promonocytes
A segmented neutrophil at lower left for size comparison
2802.describe_en: The smear shows a population of large monocytic cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and occasional small vacuoles. Nuclei are oval to indented with fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli, features that overlap with promonocytes. A segmented neutrophil is present for comparison. Because promonocytes are counted as blast equivalents, their proportion should be quantified to distinguish CMML (and its blast subgroup) from acute monocytic leukemia. Findings are compatible with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Acute leukemia requires >=20% monoblasts plus promonocytes, whereas CMML has <20% with more mature abnormal monocytes.
Reactive monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin and there is no dysplasia or clonal marker.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei, strong MPO positivity, CD34/HLA-DR negativity and PML::RARA.
Granulocytic precursors have a round eccentric nucleus, a perinuclear Golgi zone and coarser pink-purple granules, with strong MPO and negative NSE.

2738.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中一顆極大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富且充滿細顆粒，核高度分葉堆疊於上方，細胞質內可見被包入的細胞（emperipolesis）；大型成熟且過度分葉的巨核細胞是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Giant megakaryocyte, many times the diameter of surrounding cells
Hyperlobulated, overlapping nuclear lobes clustered at one pole
Abundant mature cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granularity
Probable emperipolesis: round intact cells within the cytoplasm
Background of maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes and clumped red cells
2738.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant megakaryocyte with abundant mature, finely granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobulated nucleus with numerous overlapping lobes. Several intact cells appear to lie within the cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis. Surrounding cells include maturing neutrophils and lymphocytes without increased blasts in this field. Large, mature, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes are characteristic of essential thrombocythemia. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like hypolobated nuclei and abnormal clustering rather than mature staghorn lobation.
PV megakaryocytes are pleomorphic (small and large) in a panmyelosis background rather than uniformly giant hyperlobulated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased in number but normal in size and lobation.

2674.recognize_zh: 紅血球像疊起來的硬幣排成長鏈，中央一條長串超過十顆、邊緣彼此重疊，背景呈淡粉紅色（血漿蛋白增加）；這種線狀疊錢排列就是 rouleaux formation。
features: Red cells stacked in linear coin-like chains of up to more than 10 cells
Stacks show overlapping curved borders with preserved individual outlines
Short stacks and branching chains throughout the field
Pinkish-tan background suggesting increased plasma protein
Scattered spherocytic-appearing and crenated red cells, few platelets
2674.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows extensive rouleaux formation, with red cells aligned in linear and branching stacks resembling piles of coins, some exceeding ten cells in length. The background has a faint pinkish-blue protein tint. Occasional crenated and rounded red cells without central pallor are also present, and irregular grape-like clumps typical of agglutination are not seen. Findings are consistent with rouleaux formation, suggesting elevated plasma proteins such as a monoclonal immunoglobulin or fibrinogen; serum protein electrophoresis with immunofixation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Agglutination produces irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than orderly linear stacks, and often corrects with warming.
Artifactual stacking is confined to the thick part of the smear, whereas true rouleaux persists in the thin monolayer area.
Morphology is identical; separation requires protein electrophoresis and immunofixation to exclude a monoclonal protein.

2482.recognize_zh: 這張周邊血液抹片只有紅血球，可見明顯大小不一與異形紅血球：卵圓形、淚滴形、紅血球碎片與棘狀細胞，看不到白血球與血小板；此紅血球變化不具 JMML 專一性，只能作為輔助線索。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis
Ovalocytes/elliptocytes and occasional teardrop cells
Scattered red cell fragments (schistocyte-like forms) and an echinocyte
Variable central pallor, some hypochromic cells
No leukocytes or platelets present in the field
2482.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes, occasional teardrop cells, small fragmented forms and an echinocyte, with variable central pallor. No leukocytes or platelets are included in this field, so the white cell and platelet findings that define juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia cannot be assessed. The red cell changes are nonspecific; they may be seen in JMML, but the diagnosis requires monocytosis, circulating immature myeloid and nucleated red cells, and supporting laboratory and genetic findings.
