ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows uniformly hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells without circulating immature myeloid cells or monocytosis.
Thalassemia shows microcytosis with target cells and basophilic stippling and a normal white cell differential.
MAHA shows numerous schistocytes with thrombocytopenia and hemolysis markers rather than scattered poikilocytes.

2418.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中三個異常細胞的核呈明顯雙葉或摺疊（類似蝴蝶或啞鈴形），細胞質幾乎看不到顆粒、帶淡藍色，符合低顆粒型急性前骨髓性白血病（hypogranular APL, M3v）。
features: Medium to large abnormal cells with moderate N:C ratio
Nuclei deeply folded to bilobed with a central cleft (butterfly/sliding-plate shape)
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Pale to moderately basophilic cytoplasm with sparse or no visible azurophilic granules
No Auer rods or faggot cells visible in this field
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with elongated forms; platelets decreased
2418.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of three abnormal medium-to-large cells with deeply folded, bilobed nuclei imparting a butterfly-like configuration, finely dispersed chromatin, and pale basophilic cytoplasm that is largely devoid of visible granules. Auer rods and faggot cells are not seen in this field. Platelets appear decreased. Findings are suggestive of the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR and coagulation studies for DIC are recommended.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei too, but show more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, strong nonspecific esterase positivity and are MPO weak, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO positive and HLA-DR/CD34 negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or other lymphoma with cleaved nuclei
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have clumped chromatin and circumferential hairy projections or clefted small nuclei, and lack MPO; flow shows mature B-cell markers.
Classic APL shows dense coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, whereas M3v cells appear agranular by light microscopy.

2098.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一群中型淋巴細胞，核呈明顯多葉、凹陷或花瓣狀（flower cell / clover-leaf），染色質粗糙濃縮、無明顯核仁，胞質少而淡嗜鹼性，是成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）的經典形態。
features: Cluster of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes
Markedly lobulated, indented, or cloverleaf nuclei (flower cells)
Coarse, condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Background of normochromic red cells; no platelet clumping
2098.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with markedly lobulated, indented, and cloverleaf-shaped nuclei, coarse condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with the flower cells of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires CD4+/CD25+ T-cell immunophenotype and HTLV-1 serology or proviral integration studies.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than deep polylobation, and Sézary syndrome lacks HTLV-1 and usually CD25 expression.
T-PLL cells have a prominent single nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with atypical nuclei
ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Reactive lymphocytes show abundant basophilic cytoplasm scalloping around RBCs and lack clonal CD4+ T-cell expansion.

2034.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下細胞組成很雜：小淋巴球、核偏心的漿細胞樣細胞，加上左側一顆核大、染色質開、中央有明顯核仁的免疫母細胞（immunoblast）；這種從小淋巴球到大細胞全都有的多形性浸潤，是多形性 PTLD 的特徵。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and large transformed cells
Large immunoblast (left) with vesicular nucleus and prominent central nucleolus
Plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and coarse chromatin
Intermediate cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei
Loose, edematous background with delicate stroma; occasional red cell
2034.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a polymorphous lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, intermediate cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, and scattered large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli. The background is loose and edematous. There is no monotonous sheet of large cells in this field. Findings are consistent with polymorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Monomorphic PTLD consists of sheets of large transformed cells, whereas this field shows the full spectrum from small lymphocytes to plasma cells and immunoblasts.
Infectious mononucleosis-like PTLD shows paracortical expansion with immunoblasts but preserved architecture, which cannot be judged at this high power.
cHL has diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+, CD15+, CD45- and PAX5 weak in an inflammatory background, whereas PTLD immunoblasts usually retain CD20 and CD45.
THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a background dominated by T cells and histiocytes, with few plasma cells.

1842.recognize_zh: 密集成片的芽細胞大小略有差異，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質極少，其間夾雜幾顆較小、染色質濃縮的成熟淋巴球作為大小對照，符合淋巴芽細胞白血病的骨髓取代。
features: Sheets of small to intermediate blasts with mild size variation
Very high N:C ratio with scant agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous to small in most cells
Scattered small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin for size comparison; occasional larger cell with more basophilic cytoplasm (lower left)
1842.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is diffusely replaced by small to intermediate-sized blasts with mild size variation. The blasts have very high N:C ratios, scant agranular cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered small mature lymphocytes are interspersed, and residual normal hematopoiesis is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia, pending flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; immunophenotyping for cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a is required.
MPO or myeloid antigen expression (CD13, CD33, CD117) by flow cytometry rather than B-lineage markers.
Cells are small mature lymphocytes with clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, not blasts with fine chromatin, and are TdT-negative.
Occur as a minor population with smooth condensed chromatin and show normal B-cell maturation by flow.

1586.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，多個緊密排列的結節內細胞呈強陽性（紅棕色），陽性細胞也延伸到濾泡間區，只有少數散在區域不染色；這種結節內大量陽性的模式符合濾泡型淋巴瘤，但圖上未標示抗體名稱（可能為 BCL2 或 B 細胞標記）。
features: Multiple closely packed nodules with strong, diffuse chromogen staining of nearly all cells within the nodules
Positive cells also extend into the interfollicular areas, with only patchy negative (hematoxylin-blue) zones
Nodules lack a negative germinal-center/positive mantle contrast pattern
Unstained vessel walls and a band of fibrous tissue serve as internal negative background
1586.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node at low-to-intermediate power shows strong staining of the cells within multiple closely packed neoplastic follicles, with extension of positive cells into interfollicular areas and only patchy negative zones. The antibody is not labeled in this image; if this is BCL2, positive staining within follicle centers supports a neoplastic follicular process rather than reactive germinal centers, which are BCL2-negative. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative with positive staining confined to mantle zones and interfollicular T cells.

ddx.dx: Follicular colonization by marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Colonized follicles show BCL2-positive CD10-negative marginal zone cells with residual CD10/BCL6-positive germinal center cells and FDC meshwork disruption.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous or pediatric-type follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: These variants are often BCL2-negative or weak and lack t(14;18), so a strongly BCL2-positive follicular pattern favors conventional follicular lymphoma.

1522.recognize_zh: 多顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質淡藍到深藍、邊緣可見小突起，細胞核圓或不規則（右下呈腎形），染色質中度緻密且多數可見單一明顯核仁，這種「成熟染色質加上清楚核仁」的組合是 T-PLL 前淋巴球的特徵。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of basophilic cytoplasm; some cells with small cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs
Round to irregular nuclei, including a reniform/folded nucleus at lower right
Moderately condensed chromatin with a single visible nucleolus in many cells
No cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis including a teardrop-shaped cell
1522.describe_en: Smear shows numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of basophilic agranular cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic protrusions. Nuclei are round to irregular, including a reniform form, with moderately condensed chromatin and a single distinct nucleolus in many cells. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. These prolymphocytes with mature chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli are consistent with the stated diagnosis of T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires T-cell immunophenotyping and TCL1A/inv(14) studies.

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes appear similar with prominent nucleoli but have rounder nuclei and a B-cell phenotype (CD19/CD20, sIg bright) without TCL1A rearrangement.
Blasts show finely dispersed, immature chromatin and express TdT/CD34, whereas prolymphocytes have partially condensed mature chromatin.
ATLL cells are polylobated 'flower cells' with dense chromatin and typically lack nucleoli, with HTLV-1 seropositivity.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and round nuclei without nucleoli.

1394.recognize_zh: 多顆大型異常早幼粒細胞：細胞質豐富、布滿細小紫紅色顆粒，細胞核圓、卵圓或有凹陷，染色質細緻；箭頭所指細胞內可見疑似細長的線狀包涵體（可能為 Auer 小體），符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病。
features: Large cells with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with fine red-purple azurophilic granules
Round to oval, indented or folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Arrow: cell with faint linear rod-like cytoplasmic structures, possibly Auer rods
Granules frequently overlie the nucleus, obscuring nuclear outline in some cells
Occasional small mature lymphocytes/erythroid precursors in the background
1394.describe_en: Smear, likely bone marrow aspirate, shows a predominance of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with fine red-purple azurophilic granules that partly obscure the nuclei. Nuclei are round, oval or indented with finely dispersed chromatin. The arrowed cell contains faint linear cytoplasmic structures that may represent Auer rods, although resolution limits certainty. Scattered small lymphocytes or erythroid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type), in this case reported as secondary/therapy-related APL, requiring urgent PML-RARA confirmation and coagulation assessment.

ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have a prominent perinuclear Golgi hof and show orderly maturation to myelocytes and neutrophils without Auer rods.
Blasts show salmon-colored granules and single long Auer rods with dysplastic maturing neutrophils, rather than sheets of heavily granular promyelocytes with folded nuclei.
Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine sparse granules and are nonspecific esterase positive with weak or absent MPO.
Mast cells have dark purple metachromatic granules on toluidine blue and are tryptase/CD117 positive, MPO negative.

114.recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡的生發中心內，被成群大型漿母細胞（plasmablast，細胞質豐富雙染性、核仁明顯）部分或大部分取代，周圍保留小淋巴球套區；這些大細胞 B/T 標記陰性、EBER 原位雜交陽性，符合 HHV8+/EBV+ 的生發中心親和性淋巴增生疾病（germinotropic LPD, GLD）。
features: Lymph node with preserved follicular architecture; germinal centers partially or largely replaced by cohesive clusters of large cells
Large plasmablasts with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent central nucleoli
Surrounding mantle of small lymphocytes; some follicles show concentric (onion-skin) mantles with regressed, vascularized germinal centers
Pan-lymphoid membranous markers stain background small lymphocytes but spare the large plasmablast clusters
EBER ISH: strong dark nuclear signal in the large cells; a further stain highlights the germinal-center clusters with nuclear/cytoplasmic positivity
Weak granular nuclear staining of the large cells with another marker (LANA-1-type pattern)
114.describe_en: Sections of the excised lymph node show retained follicular architecture in which multiple germinal centers are partially to largely replaced by aggregates of large plasmablastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, surrounded by intact mantle zones; occasional follicles show concentric mantle layering with regressed germinal centers. On immunostains, membranous markers highlight the background small lymphocytes while the plasmablast clusters are negative, a further marker shows nuclear/cytoplasmic positivity restricted to the germinal-center clusters, and a nuclear marker shows weak granular staining of the large cells; EBER in situ hybridization is strongly positive in the plasmablasts. The individual antibodies are not labeled on the images. Findings are consistent with HHV8+/EBV+ germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: In KSHV-MCD, LANA-1+ plasmablasts are scattered singly in the mantle zone, are EBV-negative and usually IgM lambda, whereas GLD plasmablasts fill germinal centers and are EBV+.
Extracavitary PEL forms sheets that efface nodal architecture, whereas GLD keeps the plasmablasts confined to germinal centers with preserved follicles.
Plasmablastic lymphoma diffusely effaces tissue and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative, while GLD is follicle-restricted and LANA-1 positive.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or EBV+ DLBCL
ddx.vs: These lack HHV8 LANA-1 and show CD30/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells or diffuse sheets, rather than germinal-center-restricted LANA-1+/EBER+ plasmablasts.

captions: H&E low power: lymphoid follicle with germinal center replaced by clusters of large cells
H&E: follicle with concentric mantle zone and regressed germinal center
H&E medium power: large plasmablast aggregates within germinal center
H&E high power: plasmablasts with amphophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
IHC (membranous marker, unlabeled): small lymphocytes positive, plasmablast clusters negative
IHC (membranous marker, unlabeled): subset of small lymphocytes positive, large cells negative
IHC (membranous marker, unlabeled): dense small-lymphocyte staining sparing large cells
IHC (nuclear marker, unlabeled): weak granular nuclear staining of large cells
EBER ISH: strong nuclear signal in large plasmablasts
IHC (marker unlabeled): nuclear/cytoplasmic positivity of germinal-center plasmablast clusters

50.recognize_zh: 骨切片中大片瀰漫的大型淋巴細胞，細胞核大於組織球核，呈多葉狀、凹陷或扭曲（polylobated centroblast），染色質疏鬆、可見多個小核仁與有絲分裂；B 細胞標記強膜狀陽性，符合原發骨瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with nuclei larger than histiocyte nuclei
Irregular, multilobated to cleaved nuclei with vesicular chromatin and one to several small peripheral nucleoli (polylobated centroblastic cytology)
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm; fine delicate stroma between cells
Scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies
Strong diffuse membranous positivity of the neoplastic cells on a B-cell marker IHC (likely CD20), adjacent to bone
Weaker granular cytoplasmic/Golgi-pattern staining of the large cells on a second unlabeled IHC
50.describe_en: Biopsy of the mandibular lytic lesion shows a diffuse infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells replacing the marrow space and abutting bone. The cells have multilobated and irregular nuclei with vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, with frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies; no epithelial, melanocytic or small round blue cell architecture is evident. Immunohistochemistry shows strong diffuse membranous staining with a B-cell marker (presumably CD20) and granular cytoplasmic staining with a second, unlabeled marker. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving bone, in this clinical setting primary bone lymphoma, with a polylobated centroblastic cytomorphology.

ddx.dx: Ewing sarcoma / small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are smaller and uniform with fine chromatin, lack polylobated nuclei and are CD20-negative, CD99/NKX2-2-positive.
Cells have eccentric nuclei with prominent central nucleoli and amphophilic cytoplasm and are CD20-negative, CD138/MUM1-positive with light chain restriction.
Shows cohesive nests with keratin or S100/SOX10 positivity rather than discohesive sheets of CD20+ lymphoid cells.
Contains hallmark horseshoe-nucleus cells with strong uniform CD30 and loss of B-cell markers instead of CD20+ centroblasts.

50.stain: H&E; IHC (probable CD20; second marker unlabeled)
captions: H&E high power: sheets of large cells with multilobated vesicular nuclei and mitoses
IHC (probable CD20): strong membranous staining of tumor cells adjacent to bone
IHC (marker unlabeled): granular cytoplasmic/Golgi staining of the large tumor cells
